features.Name: Command Versatility
features.Prerequisites: Adept Command, Guile, or Pokémon Education
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon takes its turn
features.Effect: Your Pokémon may give up use of a Scene or Daily Move to regain use of a Scene or Daily Move which it has already used. Your Pokémon may give up use of a Daily Move to regain use of a Scene Move, but not vice-versa. You may use [[feature:Command Versatility]] only once per Scene per Pokémon.

features.Name: Press
features.Target: Your own Pokémon
features.Effect: You hit your Pokémon, and they lose 1/6th of their Max Hit Points and are cured of [[status:Sleep]]. Raise any two of their Stats by +1 CS each, and you may add half of your Intimidate Rank to any Skill Checks made this round to make this Pokémon obey orders. Using Press on a Pokémon may make them dislike you.

features.Name: Quick Switch
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon Faints; or an opponent sends out a Pokémon
features.Effect: You may return and send out a Pokémon as a Free Action. You may perform this Feature on your turn without a [[keyword:Trigger]]. Pokémon sent out by [[feature:Quick Switch]] cannot trigger another Trainer's [[feature:Quick Switch]]. When you swap Pokémon using [[feature:Quick Switch]], you do not lose a Pokémon turn.

features.Name: Species Savant
features.Prerequisites: 3 different individual Pokémon of the same evolutionary line
features.Effect: When you take [[feature:Species Savant]], choose a single Evolutionary Family. Your Pokémon of your Chosen Evolutionary Family have each of their Base Stats increased by +1.

features.Name: Tutoring
features.Prerequisites: Novice Pokémon Education, a move that you or three of your Pokémon know
features.Frequency: One Time Use x 3 — Extended Action
features.Effect: When activating this Feature, select a Move known either by yourself or by 3 Pokémon you own. This Move is Mastered. As an Extended Action, you may have Pokémon spend 2 Tutor Points to learn a Move you have Mastered. Pokémon targeted this way can only learn Moves that they could learn by Level Up, TM, Egg Move, or Move Tutor. You may take [[feature:Tutoring]] multiple times, each time gaining 3 uses of the Feature.

features.Name: Agility Training
features.Effect: The target becomes Agile until the end of the effect duration. Agile Pokémon gain a +1 bonus to Movement Capabilities and +4 to Initiative.

features.Name: Brutal Training
features.Effect: The target becomes Brutal until the end of the effect duration. Brutal Pokémon increase the Critical-Hit and Effect Range of all attacks by +1.

features.Name: Focused Training
features.Effect: The target becomes Focused until the end of the effect duration. Focused Pokémon gain a +1 bonus to Accuracy Rolls and +2 to Skill Checks.

features.Name: Inspired Training
features.Effect: The target becomes Inspired until the end of the effect duration. Inspired Pokémon gain a +1 bonus to Evasion and +2 to Save Checks.

features.Name: Commander's Voice
features.Effect:
You may give two different [Orders] as a single Standard Action, or you may give one set of [Orders] as a Swift Action.
If this is used to use [[feature:Focused Command]] and another [Order] that has targets, the second Order applies to both Pokémon you are commanding that turn. [[feature:Commander's Voice]] doesn't allow you to use [[feature:Focused Command]] as a Swift Action.

features.Name: Focused Command
features.Prerequisites: Master Command, one of Focus, Guile, Intimidate, or Pokémon Education at Expert
features.Effect: You may have a second Pokémon take a turn this round, but both Pokémon can only take At-Will actions that round. Additionally, both Pokémon receive a -5 Penalty on all Damage Rolls. You may pay 1 AP at the beginning of the round to lift the Frequency Restriction OR the Damage Penalty for the remainder of the round, or pay 2 AP to lift both.

features.Name: Ravager Orders
features.Effect: You gain the [[feature:Reckless Advance]] and [[feature:Strike Again!]] Orders.

orders.Name: Reckless Advance
orders.Effect: While this Feature is Bound, increase the damage rolls of the target's damaging melee attacks by +8, and these attacks [[status:Tripped]](Trip) targets on Accuracy Rolls of 18+. When the target of [[feature:Reckless Advance]] hits with a damaging melee attack, they become [[status:Vulnerable]] for one full round.

orders.Name: Strike Again!
orders.Effect: The target may immediately take an additional Standard Action to use an At-Will attack.

features.Name: Marksman Orders
features.Effect: You gain the [[feature:Trick Shot]] and [[feature:Long Shot]] Orders.

orders.Name: Trick Shot
orders.Effect: While this Feature is Bound, decrease the Accuracy Roll of the target's damaging ranged attacks by -2. The Critical Hit range of those attacks is increased by +3. This Feature does not affect Moves without an AC value.

orders.Name: Long Shot
orders.Effect: The target's damaging ranged attacks have their range doubled until the end of their next turn, and deal X additional damage. X is equal to the distance in meters that the attack traveled. [[feature:Long Shot]] does not increase the size of area of effect attacks. If attacks altered by [[feature:Long Shot]] are Critical Hits, add the value of the Damage Dice Roll an additional time to the total damage.

features.Name: Trickster Orders
features.Effect: You gain the [[feature:Capricious Whirl]] and [[feature:Dazzling Dervish]] Orders.

orders.Name: Capricious Whirl
orders.Effect: While this Feature is Bound, the target has a +3 bonus to its Evasion but deals 5 less damage with all damaging attacks.

orders.Name: Dazzling Dervish
orders.Effect: Until the end of their next turn, the target adds their non-stat Evasion to their Movement Capabilities and whenever they attack a foe or Shift through a square occupied by a foe, that foe suffers a -3 penalty to all rolls until the end of their next turn. This effect may only affect a foe once per round.

features.Name: Guardian Orders
features.Effect: You gain the [[feature:Brace for Impact]] and [[feature:Sentinel Stance]] Orders.

orders.Name: Brace for Impact
orders.Effect: While this Feature is Bound, once a round, when the target uses a self-targeting Status Move, they may gain 5 Damage Reduction until the end of their next turn. They may also activate this effect as a Standard Action.

orders.Name: Sentinel Stance
orders.Effect: Until the end of your next turn, the target may attempt to Intercept attacks for allies as a Shift Action. If they do so, they gain 10 Damage Reduction against the attack. If the target is also under the effect of [[feature:Brace for Impact]], they may gain 5 Damage Reduction from it as if they had used a self-targeting Status Move.

features.Name: Precision Orders
features.Effect: You gain the [[feature:Pinpoint Strike]] and [[feature:Perfect Aim]] Orders.

orders.Name: Pinpoint Strike
orders.Effect: Increase the Accuracy and Effect Range of the target's damaging attacks by +2. These attacks deal 5 less damage, before applying weakness and resistance.

orders.Name: Perfect Aim
orders.Effect: The next damaging attack the target performs before the end of your next turn automatically hits and ignores Defensive Abilities but deals damage as if it were resisted one step further than normal. You may still roll to trigger any Effect Ranges or Critical Hits. All targets of the attack may not activate any Blessings in response, and the attack may not be Intercepted or avoided in any way (ex: with [[ability:Dodge]], [[keyword:Shield]] Moves, etc).

features.Name: Blur
features.Effect: Attacks and Moves targeting you that don't require an Accuracy Check now require one, as though they had Accuracy Check of 2. You may only apply half of your Evasion to these Attacks and Moves.

features.Name: Defender
features.Effect: Using the Intercept Maneuvers requires only a Shift Action Interrupt.

features.Name: Dive
features.Trigger: You are targeted by a Ranged 1-Target Attack, or are in a Cone, Burst, Blast, or Line.
features.Effect: You may immediately Shift 1 Meter, and then become [[status:Tripped]]. This Feature cannot be used if you are [[status:Stuck]], Grappled, or otherwise impaired from Shifting. This Feature causes you to dodge Ranged attacks aimed at you, and may let you avoid Cones, Bursts, Blasts, or Lines if the shift removes you from the area of effect.

features.Name: Fighter's Versatility
features.Prerequisites: Learned two Scene or Daily Moves
features.Trigger: You gain Initiative.
features.Effect: You may give up use of a Scene or Daily Move to regain use of a Scene or Daily Move which you have already used. You may give up use of a Daily Move to regain use of a Scene Move, but not vice-versa.

features.Name: Multi-Tasking
features.Trigger: You gain Initiative.
features.Effect: You may take two Standard Actions instead of one this turn, but both actions must have an At-Will Frequency.

features.Name: Signature Move
features.Effect: Choose a Move you know. Increase the Move's Frequency one step, as if you had used a [[item:PP Up]]. This choice cannot be changed once made. This Feature may not select Moves known through temporary means, nor can these Moves be used to qualify for this Feature.

features.Name: Type Expertise
features.Rank 1 Prerequisites: Level 9, 3 Moves of the Chosen Type in your Move List
features.Rank 2 Prerequisites: Level 9, 3 Moves of the Chosen Type in your Move List
features.Effect: Each Rank, choose a Type of which you know at least 3 Moves. You gain STAB for the chosen Type. STAB is never applied to Struggle Attacks.

features.Name: Walk It Off
features.Effect: Remove one Injury from yourself and regain 1/4th of your maximum Hit Points. This Injury removal doesn't count against the natural healing limit on Injuries each day.

features.Name: First Aid Expertise
features.Target: Pokémon or Trainers
features.Effect: The target may remove one Injury, has all Hit Points restored, and is cured of all Status Afflictions. You may use [[feature:First Aid Expertise]] only once per day per target. [[feature:First Aid Expertise]] requires access to a [[item:First Aid Kit]].

features.Name: Let Me Help You With That
features.Trigger: An allied Trainer fails a Skill Check in a Skill you have Ranked at Novice or higher.
features.Effect: The ally may re-roll the Skill Check with a Bonus equal to your Skill Rank.

features.Name: Poké Ball Crafter
features.Prerequisites: [[edge:Basic Balls]], Poké Ball Repair, Expert Technology
features.Effect: You may craft [[item:Dusk Ball]](Dusk), [[item:Dive Ball]](Dive), [[item:Heal Ball]](Heal), [[item:Luxury Ball]](Luxury), [[item:Net Ball]](Net), [[item:Nest Ball]](Nest), [[item:Quick Ball]](Quick), [[item:Repeat Ball]](Repeat), or [[item:Timer Ball]](Timer) Balls for ₽700. Requires access to a [[item:Poké Ball Tool Box]].

features.Name: PokéManiac
features.Target: A Pokémon
features.Effect: Make a Pokemon Education Check with a DC of 10. If you succeed, you determine the target's Level, Types, Nature, and Abilities.

features.Name: Psionic Sight
features.Effect: You are able to visibly see any Psychic Residue left on Humans or Pokémon due to the effects of Psionic abilities. Each Human or Pokémon leaves distinct Psychic Residue on their targets; you are easily able to distinguish which targets have been affected by the same Psionic, though to identify that Psionic you need to have a way of knowing their signature (such as simply seeing them do it, and seeing the resulting signature).

features.Name: Skill Monkey
features.Prerequisites: Three Skills at Adept Rank or higher
features.Trigger: You make a Skill Check
features.Effect: You may re-roll the triggering Skill Check with a +2 Bonus, taking the new result. This Feature may be used to re-roll a specific roll only once.

features.Name: Arcane Training
features.Prerequisites: Novice Occult Education, [[edge:Elemental Connection]] or [[edge:Mystic Senses]]
features.Effect: You may use Arcane Weapons. Attacks made with your Arcane Weapons share the Type of your [[edge:Elemental Connection]]. If you have [[edge:Mystic Senses]], these Attacks deal Normal Type Damage. Arcane Weapon users that qualified through [[edge:Mystic Senses]] or [[edge:Elemental Connection]] (Normal) gain a +5 Bonus to Damage Rolls and a +2 Bonus to Effect Range when using Arcane Weapon Attacks. When wielding an Arcane Weapon, you may resist Disarm Maneuvers with your Occult Education.

features.Name: Smith
features.Rank 1 Effect: You may create Simple Weapons for ₽1000, [[item:Light Shield]](Light Shields) for ₽1,500, and [[item:Light Armor]] for ₽4,000.
features.Rank 2 Effect: You may create Fine Weapons for ₽2,000, [[item:Helmet]](Helmets) for ₽1,125, [[item:Heavy Shield]](Heavy Shields) for ₽2,250 and [[item:Heavy Armor]] for ₽5,000.

features.Name: Type Sync
features.Prerequisites: [[edge:Elemental Connection]]; a Type-Linked Class; Adept Medicine, Occult, or Tech Education
features.Target: Your Pokémon
features.Effect: The Target gains the Type of your [[edge:Elemental Connection]] as an additional Type, or has one of their Types replaced by that Type. See the Type Changes section (page 436) for more information and suggestions. A Pokémon may be targeted by [[feature:Type Sync]] only once. This Feature may be performed One Time for each Rank above Untrained you have of your highest of Medicine, Occult, or Tech Education, up to a maximum of 4 times at Master Rank.

features.Name: Nurse
features.Trigger: You take an Extended Rest
features.Effect:
During this Extended Rest, Pokémon and Trainers in your care gain the benefits listed below. The AP Drain cost from triggering this Feature is applied after the Extended Rest is completed and AP Drain has otherwise been restored.
» They heal 1/8th of their Max Hit Points per half hour of rest instead of 1/16th (does not stack with [[item:Bandages]]).
» If the Extended Rest lasts at least 6 hours, they may remove 1 Injury.

features.Name: Ace Trainer
features.Trigger: You spend at least half an hour Training your Pokémon
features.Effect: For each Pokémon that has been Trained during this time, choose a Stat besides HP; that Stat becomes Trained until an Extended Rest is taken. The default State of Trained Stats is +1 Combat Stages instead of 0. A Pokémon may have only one Trained Stat at a time.

features.Name: Perseverance
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon gains an Injury
features.Effect: The target instead does not gain an Injury. [[feature:Perseverance]] may activate only once per Scene per target.

features.Name: Elite Trainer
features.Effect: Choose [[feature:Agility Training]], [[feature:Brutal Training]], [[feature:Focused Training]], or [[feature:Inspired Training]]. You gain the chosen Feature, even if you do not meet the prerequisites. When training, you may apply up to two different [Training] Features on each of your Pokémon. If you already have all of these Features, instead pick another Feature for which you qualify.

features.Name: Critical Moment
features.Target: Your Pokemon with [Training] Features applied
features.Effect: The bonuses from your Pokemon's [Training] are tripled until the end of your next turn.

features.Name: Top Percentage
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon levels up to a Level evenly divisible by 5
features.Effect: Your Pokémon gains an extra Tutor Point. [[feature:Top Percentage]] may be used on a single Pokémon a maximum of 4 times. Once a Pokémon has gained 4 Tutor Points in this way, increase each of that Pokémon's Base Stats by +1.

features.Name: Signature Technique
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon with at least 2 Tutor Points remaining
features.Effect: The target loses 2 Tutor Points. Choose one Move on the Target's Move List. That Move becomes the target's [[feature:Signature Technique]], and you may apply one of the modifications on the next page to the Move. The Move being modified must fit the category of the modification, and you must have the associated Training Feature to apply a modification. A Pokémon may only have one [[feature:Signature Technique]] at a time. If you choose to teach a Pokémon a different [[feature:Signature Technique]], the old one is lost, and 1 Tutor Point is refunded. 1 Tutor Point is also refunded if the Pokémon ever forgets a [[feature:Signature Technique]] Move.

features.Name: Champ in the Making
features.Trigger: You use [[feature:Ace Trainer]] to give Pokémon Trained Stats
features.Effect: Choose two Trained Stats for each Pokémon instead of one. A Pokémon may only have two Trained Stats this way.

techniques.Name: Cone, Line, Burst, and Blast Moves
techniques.Scattershot – [[feature:Agility Training: Instead of the Move's normal range, it has a range of 4m, 3 Targets.
techniques.Shock and Awe – [[feature:Inspired Train: Foes targeted by the Move take a -2 penalty to Save Checks and a -1 Penalty to Evasion until the end of the user's next turn.
techniques.Vicious Storm – [[feature:Brutal Trainin: The Move gains the [[keyword:Smite]] keyword. Applicable to [[feature:Damaging Moves]] only.

techniques.Name: Single Target Moves
techniques.Guarding Strike – [[feature:Inspired Tra: If this Move hits, the user gains +5 Damage Reduction against the target of the attack until the end of their next turn.
techniques.Unbalancing Blow – [[feature:Brutal Trai: Whether the Move hits or misses, the target becomes [[status:Vulnerable]] until the next time they are hit by a Damaging Attack or one full round has passed, whichever comes first.
techniques.Reliable Attack – [[feature:Focused Trai: If the Move misses its target, its Frequency is not spent and the user may immediately make a Struggle Attack as a Free Action. Cannot be applied to Moves with the [[keyword:Smite]] keyword.

techniques.Name: Damaging Moves
techniques.Alternative Energy – [[feature:Focused T: Switch the Class of the Move from Physical to Special or vice versa.
techniques.Bloodied Speed – [[feature:Agility Train: This Move may be used as [[keyword:Priority]](Priority (Advanced)) if the user has less than half of their maximum Hit Points.
techniques.Double Down – [[feature:Brutal Training]: The Move gains the [[keyword:Double Strike]] keyword. Effects and Effect-Ranges may be triggered only once (but either roll may trigger the effect). This may only be applied to Moves with a Damage Base of 4 or less, and may not be applied to Moves whose Damage Base change upon certain conditions (such as [[move:Fury Cutter]] or [[move:Ice Ball]]) or moves with Special-Case Damage (such as [[move:Night Shade]]).

techniques.Name: Status Moves
techniques.Burst of Motivation – [[feature:Inspired: After this Move is Resolved, the user may increase any Stats with negative Combat Stages by up to +2 Combat Stages (but this cannot put Combat Stages above +0 CS total).
techniques.Supreme Concentration – [[feature:Focuse: This Move may be used even if the user is [[status:Paralysis]](Paralyzed), [[status:Flinch]](Flinched), [[status:Rage]](Enraged), or has failed their [[status:Confusion]] Save Check.
techniques.Double Curse – [[feature:Agility Trainin: The user may target an additional foe with this Attack. This may be applied only to 1-Target Moves.

features.Name: Capture Specialist
features.Prerequisites: Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, or Survival at Novice; Guile, or Perception at Novice
features.Effect: You gain two [[feature:Capture Techniques]] of your choice, found on the next page. You must meet any prerequisites of the Technique.

features.Name: Advanced Capture Techniques
features.Rank 2 Prerequisites: [[feature:Capture Specialist]], any 2 Skills at Adept Rank
features.Rank 3 Prerequisites: [[feature:Capture Specialist]], any 2 Skills at Expert Rank
features.Rank 4 Prerequisites: [[feature:Capture Specialist]], any 3 Skills at Expert Rank
features.Effect: At each Rank, you gain two [[feature:Capture Techniques]] of your choice, found on the next page. You must meet any prerequisites of the Technique. You may qualify for [[feature:Advanced Capture Techniques]]' prerequisites with the Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, Survival, Guile, or Perception Skills only.

features.Name: Captured Momentum
features.Trigger: You successfully Capture a Pokémon
features.Effect:
Choose One Effect:
» You or your Pokémon gain a +2 bonus to their next Accuracy Roll during this combat.
» You subtract your highest Skill Rank out of Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, Survival, Guile, or Perception from your next Capture Roll during this combat.
» You gain 1 Temporary Action Point that disappears after one full round.

features.Name: Gotta Catch 'Em All
features.Effect: Every time you Capture a Wild Pokémon that is a member of an evolutionary family of which you own no other Pokémon, you gain 1 Collector Stack. Whenever you make a Capture Roll, you may spend up to three Collector Stacks to gain an equal bonus to your Capture Roll, or you may spend three Collector Stacks to re-roll entirely.

techniques.Name: Capture Skills
techniques.Effect: You gain a Skill Edge for which you qualify. It must be applied to Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, Survival, Guile, or Perception. You may take [[feature:Capture Skills]] up to two times.

techniques.Name: Curve Ball
techniques.Effect: Whenever you hit a target with a Poké Ball, you may deal damage as if you had hit them with a Struggle Attack. This damage triggers before any of the Poké Ball's functions (such as making a Capture Check, releasing a Pokémon, etc.).

techniques.Name: Devitalizing Throw
techniques.Trigger: A Pokémon escapes from a Poké Ball you threw
techniques.Effect: Choose One Effect: The triggering target becomes [[status:Slowed]]; the triggering target loses one Combat Stage in a Stat of your choice; or the triggering target suffers a -3 penalty to their next Save Roll.

techniques.Name: Fast Pitch
techniques.Effect: You immediately throw a Poké Ball.

techniques.Name: Snare
techniques.Effect: You subtract -10 from Capture Rolls made against Pokémon drawn into an encounter by [[item:Bait]], that are currently distracted by [[item:Bait]], or are in a [[item:Hand Net]], Lasso, [[item:Weighted Nets]](Weighted Net), or [[status:Stuck]] because of a [[item:Glue Cannon]].

techniques.Name: Tools of the Trade
techniques.Effect: Add +2 to all Accuracy Rolls made with Poké Balls, [[item:Hand Net]](Hand Nets), Lassos, [[item:Weighted Nets]], [[item:Glue Cannon]](Glue Cannons) and Cap Cannons. Add +2 to Athletics Checks made when reeling in a Pokémon with a [[item:Fishing Rod]], and add +4 to 1d20 rolls made to see if a Pokémon is attracted by [[item:Bait]] or a [[item:Fishing Lure]].

techniques.Name: Catch Combo
techniques.Prerequisites: 3 of Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, Survival, Guile, or Perception Skills at Expert Rank
techniques.Trigger: Your Pokémon's attack faints a Wild Pokémon.
techniques.Effect: You may immediately throw a Poké Ball against the triggering Wild Pokémon, and it may be Captured even though it is knocked out. Calculate Capture Rate as if the target had 1 HP. If the Capture Attempt fails, the Pokémon is knocked out as normal.

techniques.Name: False Strike
techniques.Prerequisites: 3 of Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, Survival, Guile, or Perception at Expert Rank
techniques.Trigger: You or your Pokémon's attack faints a Wild Pokémon.
techniques.Effect: The Wild Pokémon is instead lowered to 1 Hit Point.

techniques.Name: Relentless Pursuit
techniques.Prerequisites: 3 of Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, Survival, Guile, or Perception Skills at Expert Rank
techniques.Trigger: A foe attempts to run away
techniques.Effect: Before the target moves from its starting location, one of your Pokémon on the field may immediately Shift and use a Struggle Attack as an [[keyword:Interrupt]]. If this attack hits, the target is [[status:Tripped]].

features.Prerequisites: Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, or Survival at Novice; Guile, or Perception at Novice
features.Effect: You gain two [[feature:Capture Techniques]] of your choice, found on the next page. You must meet any prerequisites of the Technique.

features.Name: Advanced Capture Techniques
features.Rank 2 Prerequisites: [[feature:Capture Specialist]], any 2 Skills at Adept Rank
features.Rank 3 Prerequisites: [[feature:Capture Specialist]], any 2 Skills at Expert Rank
features.Rank 4 Prerequisites: [[feature:Capture Specialist]], any 3 Skills at Expert Rank
features.Effect: At each Rank, you gain two [[feature:Capture Techniques]] of your choice, found on the next page. You must meet any prerequisites of the Technique. You may qualify for [[feature:Advanced Capture Techniques]]' prerequisites with the Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, Survival, Guile, or Perception Skills only.

» You gain 1 Temporary Action Point that disappears after one full round.

features.Trigger: Your make a Capture Roll.
features.Effect: You may switch the rolled digits on your 1d100 roll. For example, if you roll a 91, that can be switched to a 19. This does not turn a roll of 1 into a "Natural" roll of 100.

techniques.Effect: You gain a Skill Edge for which you qualify. It must be applied to Acrobatics, Athletics, Stealth, Survival, Guile, or Perception. You may take [[feature:Capture Skills]] up to two times.

features.Name: Commander
features.Effect: Choose one of [[feature:Ravager Orders]], [[feature:Marksman Orders]], [[feature:Trickster Orders]], [[feature:Guardian Orders]], or [[feature:Precision Orders]]. You gain the chosen Feature, even if you do not meet its prerequisites.

features.Name: Mobilize
features.Target: Any Ally
features.Effect: The target cannot provoke Attacks of Opportunity on their next turn. [[feature:Mobilize]] may target an Ally only once per encounter.

features.Name: Leadership
features.Effect: You may use [Orders] that have targets to target any Ally, even if normally those [Orders] would only let you apply the effect to your own Pokemon. Any other conditions still apply.

features.Name: Battle Conductor
features.Trigger: You give [Orders] with a Frequency of At-Will that have targets
features.Effect: You may target up to two additional Allies with the [Orders].

features.Name: Complex Orders
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Commander]], at least two Features with the [Orders] Tag that have targets
features.Trigger: You give [Orders] that have targets.
features.Effect: You may choose a different Order to give to each Target. You must pay all AP costs and follow Frequency restrictions for all Orders used in this way.

features.Name: Tip the Scales
features.Trigger: You give [Orders] that have targets.
features.Effect: Your [Orders] with an At-Will Frequency instead target all allies within 10 Meters.

features.Name: Scheme Twist
features.Trigger: You give [Orders] with a Daily or Scene Frequency that have Targets.
features.Effect: You may target up to two additional Allies with the [Orders].

features.Name: Coordinator
features.Prerequisites: [[edge:Grace]], Novice Charm, Command, Guile, Intimidate, or Intuition
features.Effect: Your Pokémon may reroll a single Appeal Roll or Damage Roll. This Feature may be used only once per Contest, and once per Pokémon per Scene.

features.Name: Decisive Director
features.Target: A Pokémon
features.Effect: Add or subtract X from the target's Initiative until the end of your next turn. X is equal to your Charm Rank doubled.

features.Name: Adaptable Performance
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon's Turn to use a Move in a Contest
features.Effect: Choose two of your Pokémon's Moves. Your Pokémon may perform your Contest Move as if had the Contest Typing of one of your chosen Moves, and had the effects of the other. You may not use either move on the next round of the contest. This effect may be used once per Contest.

features.Name: Flexible Preparations
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Adaptable Performance]], Adept Charm, Command, Guile, Intimidate, or Intuition
features.Target: A Pokémon that has Contest Stats from Poffins
features.Effect: The target may reallocate up to 2d6 of Poffin-Derived Contest Stats from one Contest Stat to another. This effect lasts until the end of the day.

features.Name: Innovation
features.Target: A Pokémon with at least 1 Tutor Point.
features.Effect: The target loses 1 Tutor Point, and then learns a Move created with [[feature:Innovation]]. See the next section for details on creating Moves for this Feature. A Pokémon may only have one Move created by [[feature:Innovation]] at a time.

features.Name: Nuanced Performance
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Coordinator]], Expert Charm, Command, Guile, Intimidate, or Intuition
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon miss all targets with a Move
features.Effect: That Move's Frequency is not expended. This does not work with Moves that may fail to activate, such as moves with the [[keyword:Execute]] keyword.

features.Name: Reliable Performance
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Nuanced Performance]], Master Charm, Command, Guile, Intimidate, or Intuition
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon makes an Appeal Roll, Accuracy Check, or Skill Check
features.Effect: For appeal rolls, instead of making the Appeal Roll, you gain 1 Appeal Point for each Dice you would have rolled. For Accuracy Checks, act as if you had rolled a 10. For Skill Checks, multiply 3.5 by your Pokémon's Skill Rank, and use the resulting number as the result of your roll, rounded down. For all rolls, add or subtract any modifiers as normal.

features.Name: Innovation Moves
features.Description:
The Coordinator's "[[feature:Innovation]]" Feature lets the [[feature:Coordinator]] create new Moves for their Pokémon. These Moves can serve to fill voids in Move Lists for both Battles and Contests and provide utility.
To create a Move, first choose a Contest Type. This affects the Move's effects and of course its role in Contests.
Next choose a Contest Effect. Look at the "Contest Effects" section (page 266) under "Contests" for the full list. Pick one. That's right, any of them. This determines what the Move does during a Contest, of course.
Third, choose one of the four templates below. This determines the Move's effects in Battle. These are modified by the Contest Type of the Move. Remember, Cool is associated with Attack, Tough with Defense, Beauty with Special Attack, Smart with Special Defense, and Cute with Speed.
And finally, name your Move! This is the best part!

templates.Name: Template #1
templates.Effect:
The user generates 3 Contest Boons. These may be used as a Swift Action on their turn to gain one of the effects below, based on this Move's Contest Type.
» Beauty: Use when declaring an attack (before Accuracy Roll) to gain a +3 bonus to Effect Range for that attack.
» Cool: Use when declaring an attack (before Accuracy Roll) to gain a +3 bonus to Critical Hit Range for that attack.
» Cute: Use during your turn to gain +3 Evasion for one full round.
» Smart: Use when declaring an attack (before Accuracy Roll) to gain a +3 bonus to Accuracy for that attack.
» Tough: Use at the start of a turn to avoid all loss of Hit Points from Status Afflictions, [[keyword:Weather]], and [[keyword:Recoil]] for that turn.

templates.Name: Template #2
templates.Effect: The target has the Stat associated with this Move's Contest Type lowered by -2 Combat Stages. This Move cannot miss.

templates.Name: Template #3
templates.Effect: Make a Struggle Attack, increasing the damage roll by +5. Follow all other normal rules for making Struggle attacks, including any modifications from capabilities, features, or special effects. On 18+, the user's Stat associated with the Contest Type of this Move is raised by +1 Combat Stage. This Move's Effect Range is extended by +1 for every two Contest Dice the user has that matches this Move's Contest Type.

templates.Name: Template #4
templates.Effect: All allies in the Burst besides the user gain +1 Combat Stage in the Stat associated with the Contest Type of this Move.

features.Name: Hobbyist
features.Effect: You gain three Skill Edges that Rank Up a Skill for which you qualify.

features.Name: Dilettante
features.Effect:
Each Rank of [[feature:Dilettante]], you gain both an Edge and a General Feature from the lists below. You may gain the chosen Edge and Feature even if you do not meet the Skill prerequisites. You must meet any other Prerequisites. Whenever you gain a Feature or Edge this way, change any Skill Rank applications or Skill Checks mandated directly by the Edge or Feature into your choice of General Education or Perception Skill Checks or Rank applications instead.
» Edges: [[edge:Acrobat]], [[edge:Apricorn Balls]], [[edge:Basic Balls]], [[edge:Basic Cooking]], [[edge:Basic Martial Arts]], [[edge:Beast Master]], [[edge:Breeder]], [[edge:Dynamism]], [[edge:Gem Lore]], [[edge:Grace]], [[edge:Green Thumb]], [[edge:Groomer]], [[edge:Instinctive Aptitude]], [[edge:Instruction]], [[edge:Intimidating Presence]], [[edge:Iron Mind]], [[edge:Medic Training]], [[edge:Mounted Prowess]], [[edge:Repel Crafter]], [[edge:Slippery]], [[edge:Swimmer]], [[edge:Train the Reserves]].
» Features: [[feature:Command Versatility]], [[feature:Commander's Voice]], [[feature:Defender]], [[feature:Dive]], [[feature:First Aid Expertise]], [[feature:Let Me Help You With That]], [[feature:Poké Ball Crafter]], [[feature:PokéManiac]], [[feature:Press]], [[feature:Quick Switch]], [[feature:Skill Monkey]], [[feature:Species Savant]], any [Training] Feature, [[feature:Tutoring]], [[feature:Walk It Off]].
Whenever you gain a Feature or Edge this way, change any Skill Rank applications or Skill Checks mandated directly by the Edge or Feature into your choice of General Education or Perception Skill Checks or Rank applications instead.

features.Name: Dabbler
features.Effect: At the Level 5, 10, 20, 30, and 40 Character Advancement Level Milestones, if you choose to gain Bonus Stats, you also gain an Edge for which you qualify. If you choose Bonus Edges or Features, you also gain +2 to your choice of Attack or Special Attack. This applies retroactively.
features.Note: It takes a long time for this Feature to bear fruit. Talk to your GM about how long the campaign will last and whether you will reach higher Levels.

features.Name: Look and Learn
features.Effect: When you activate [[feature:Look and Learn]], you may gain any of the Features below even though they are Features from other Classes. You do not need to meet their normal prerequisites, but you must meet their Prerequisites listed here. [[feature:Look and Learn]] can be used two times; once to learn a Feature from the "Scene Features" List, and once to learn a Feature from the "Action Point Features List".

features.Name: Mentor
features.Prerequisites: Two of Charm, Intimidate, Intuition, or Pokémon Education at Novice Rank
features.Target: A Pokémon with at least 1 Tutor Point remaining
features.Effect: The target loses 1 Tutor Point, and then learns a move from its tutor list marked with a (N), or any move on its level-up list learned at X Level or lower, where X is the target's current Level plus the sum of your Mentor Skill Ranks. Note that despite being Tutored, these Moves count as if they were "natural" for organizational purposes.
features.Special: When you take [[feature:Mentor]], choose two of Charm, Intimidate, Intuition, and Pokémon Education to become your Mentor Skills. The Skills you choose must be at Novice Rank or higher.

features.Name: Lessons
features.Effect: You may perform any [[feature:Mentor Lessons]](Mentor Lesson) for which you qualify.

features.Name: Expand Horizons
features.Target: Your Pokémon
features.Effect: Your Pokémon gains 3 Tutor Points. A Pokémon may be targeted by [[feature:Expand Horizons]] only once.

features.Name: Guidance
features.Effect: Your Pokémon's base Move List Limit is increased by +1 (Reminder: The default Move List Limit is 6).

features.Name: Move Tutor
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Mentor]], one Mentor Skill at Expert Rank
features.Target: A Pokémon with at least 2 Tutor Points.
features.Effect: The target loses 2 Tutor Points, and learns any move from its Tutor List.

features.Name: Egg Tutor
features.Target: A Pokémon with at least 2 Tutor Points.
features.Effect: The target loses 2 Tutor Points, and learns any Move from its Egg Move List. A Pokémon may be targeted by [[feature:Egg Tutor]] only one time.

features.Name: Lifelong Learning
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Move Tutor]], one Mentor Skill at Master Rank
features.Effect: Your Pokémon may have up to 4 Moves from their Move List come from TMs or Move Tutors.

Mentor Lessons.Name: Changing Viewpoints
Mentor Lessons.Target: A Pokémon with at least 1 Tutor Point.
Mentor Lessons.Effect: The target loses a Tutor Point, and you may change the target's Nature to any other Nature which either raises the same Stat as its current nature, or lowers the same Stat as its current Nature.

Mentor Lessons.Name: Empowered Development
Mentor Lessons.Target: A Pokémon with at least 1 Tutor Point
Mentor Lessons.Effect: The target loses 1 Tutor Point, and gains any three of the following Poké Edges: [[pokeedge:Skill Improvement]], [[pokeedge:Advanced Mobility]], or [[pokeedge:Capability Training]]. A Pokémon may be targeted only once by [[feature:Empowered Development]]. The target may gain Poké Edges this way even if they do not meet the "Prerequisites", however, they must still follow other limitations; [[pokeedge:Advanced Mobility]] can only improve a Movement Capability once, for example.

Mentor Lessons.Name: Corrective Learning
Mentor Lessons.Target: A Pokémon that has spent Tutor Points on a Poké Edge or a Feature's effect
Mentor Lessons.Effect: The target loses one "Effect" gained from a Poké Edge or Feature and refunds all Tutor Points spent on it.

Mentor Lessons.Name: Versatile Teachings
Mentor Lessons.Prerequisites: [[feature:Mentor]], Pokémon Education as a Mentor Skill
Mentor Lessons.Target: A Pokémon with at least 1 Tutor Point
Mentor Lessons.Effect: The target loses 1 Tutor Point and may exchange one of its Basic Abilities for any other of its species' Basic Abilities or one of its Advanced Abilities for any of its species' Basic or Advanced Abilities.
Mentor Lessons.Note: You may NOT activate [[feature:Versatile Teachings]] to reroll Abilities that require a roll to determine characteristics, such as [[ability:Serpent's Mark]] and [[ability:Color Theory]].

features.Name: Cheerleader
features.Target: Your Pokémon with at least 2 Tutor Points remaining
features.Effect: Your Pokémon loses 2 Tutor Points and gains the [[ability:Friend Guard]] Ability.

features.Name: Moment of Action
features.Target: Up to two Allied Trainers
features.Effect: Each target gains 1 Temporary Action Point. These Action Points disappear after one full Round.

features.Name: Inspirational Support
features.Effect: Whenever your Pokémon with [[ability:Friend Guard]] targets an Ally with an Ability or Status Move, the targeted Ally becomes Cheered.

features.Name: Cheers
features.Trigger: You use [Orders]
features.Effect: The target or targets of the triggering [Orders] are Cheered for 1 full round. While Cheered, the target's Combat Stages cannot be lowered by foe's attacks, features, or abilities. This Feature costs 0 AP if the triggering effect affects only one ally, and costs 1 AP if it affects two or more.

features.Name: Bring it On!
features.Effect:
You may trigger Bring It On! whenever...
» A Cheered Ally takes Damage, to grant them 5 Damage Reduction agains the triggering Damage.
» A Cheered Ally makes a Save Check, to let them roll an additional Save Check and use the best result.
» A Cheered Ally Takes a Breather, to grant them Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charm Rank.

features.Name: Go, Fight, Win!
features.Effect:
Choose and perform one of the cheers below. You may perform each Cheer only once per Scene.
» Show Your Best!: Choose Def or Sp.Def, all allies on the field gain +1 CS in the Chosen Stat.
» Don't Stop Now!: All allies on the Field gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charm Rank.
» I Believe In You!: All allies on the Field gain a +2 bonus to Evasion for one full Round.

features.Name: Keep Fighting!
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon or an Ally Trainer with over 1 Hit Point is reduced to 0 Hit Points or lower
features.Effect: That Ally's Hit Point count is reduced to 1 instead, and then gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charm Rank doubled.

features.Name: Cheerleader
features.Trigger: You use Orders
features.Effect: Choose Cheered, Excited, or Motivated. All allies affected by the triggering effect gain the chosen condition. This Feature costs 0 AP if the triggering effect affects only one ally, and costs 1 AP if it affects two or more.

features.Name: Cheer Brigade
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon with at least 2 Tutor Points remaining
features.Effect: Your Pokémon loses 2 Tutor Points and gains the [[ability:Friend Guard]] Ability.

features.Name: Gleeful Interference
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon with the [[ability:Friend Guard]] Ability hits a foe with a damaging attack
features.Effect: The triggering foe gains a -2 penalty to Accuracy for one full Round.

features.Name: Inspirational Support
features.Effect: You may trigger [[feature:Cheerleader]] as a Free Action when your Pokémon with [[ability:Friend Guard]] activate an Ability or Status Move that affects only allies.
features.Note: When considering effects that could trigger [[feature:Cheerleader]] this way, aside from the obvious Moves like [[move:Helping Hand]] and Abilities like [[ability:Plus]] and [[ability:Minus]], think about [[keyword:Blessing]](Blessings), [[keyword:Coat]](Coats), etc too!

features.Name: Moment of Action
features.Target: Up to two Allied Trainers
features.Effect: Each target gains 1 Temporary Action Point. These Action Points disappear after one full Round.

features.Name: Go, Fight, Win!
features.Effect:
Choose and perform one of the cheers below. You may perform each Cheer only once per Scene.
» Show Your Best!: Choose Defense or Special Defense. All allies on the field gain +1 Combat Stage in the Chosen Stat and become Motivated.
» Don't Stop Now!: All allies on the field gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charm Rank and become Excited.
 I Believe In You!: All allies on the field gain a +2 bonus to Evasion for one full Round, and become Cheered.

features.Name: Keep Fighting!
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon or an Ally Trainer with over 1 Hit Point is reduced to 0 Hit Points or lower
features.Effect: That Ally's Hit Point count is reduced to 1 instead, and then gains Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charm Rank doubled.

features.Name: Duelist
features.Target: A Pokémon or Trainer
features.Effect:
The Foe becomes Tagged; or if the foe is already Tagged, the foe loses the Tag. Only one foe can be Tagged this way at a time. If a new Foe is Tagged, all other Tags are lost.
Your Pokémon under the effects of [[feature:Focused Training]] gain half their Momentum (rounded up) as a Bonus to Accuracy and Evasion against Tagged Foes, but as long as a Foe is Tagged, they do not benefit from [[feature:Focused Training]]'s Accuracy Bonus against other foes.
features.Mechanic – Momentum:
» Your Pokémon begins each Scene with 0 Momentum.
» At the end of each Combat round, your Pokémon gains +1 Momentum.
» Whenever your Pokémon hits a Tagged foe, they gain +1 Momentum.
» Your Pokémon has a maximum of 6 Momentum. So use a d6 to track it.
» All Momentum is lost when your Pokémon Faints, your Pokémon is recalled, or combat ends.

features.Name: Expend Momentum
features.Target: Your Pokémon under the effects of [[feature:Focused Training]]
features.Effect:
Apply one of the following effects on the target by spending that much Momentum.
» Spend 1 Momentum: Your Pokémon regains use of an EOT Frequency Move.
» Spend 2 Momentum: Your Pokémon automatically rolls an 11 on one d20 Roll of your choice on their next turn.
» Spend 3 Momentum: Your Pokémon regains a use of Scene Frequency Move. May be chosen only once per Scene per Pokémon.

features.Name: Effective Methods
features.Target: Your Pokémon with at least 2 Tutor Points remaining
features.Effect: Your Pokémon loses 2 Tutor Points and gains your choice of the [[ability:Exploit]] or [[ability:Tolerance]] Ability. You may only target a Pokémon once with [[feature:Effective Methods]].

features.Name: Directed Focus
features.Effect: Whenever your Pokémon with the [[ability:Exploit]] or [[ability:Tolerance]] Ability are targeted by an [Order], deal Super-Effective Damage, or take Super-Effective Damage, they gain +1 Momentum after all effects of the Move or Order are resolved.

features.Name: Type Methodology
features.Trigger: See Effect
features.Effect:
Effects depend on whether your Pokémon has the [[ability:Tolerance]] or [[ability:Exploit]] ability.
» Whenever your Pokémon with [[ability:Tolerance]] takes Super-Effective damage from a Tagged foe, your Pokémon may lose 2 Momentum to Resist that attack one step.
» Whenever your Pokémon with [[ability:Exploit]] deals Resisted damage to a Tagged foe, your Pokémon may lose 2 Momentum to increase the effectiveness of the attack one step.

features.Name: Duelist's Manual
features.Target: Your Pokémon under the effects of [[feature:Focused Training]]
features.Effect:
Apply one of the following effects. To choose an effect, your Pokémon must have a certain amount of Momentum. ([[feature:Duelist's Manual]] does not spend Momentum).
» 1 Momentum: Your Pokémon doubles theirbonuses from [[ability:Tolerance]] or [[ability:Exploit]] until the end of their next turn and may change their [[ability:Tolerance]] Ability into [[ability:Exploit]], or vice versa, until the end of their next turn.
» 2 Momentum: Your Pokémon's next [[keyword:Pass]], Cone, Close Blast, or Burst attack becomes a single target Melee attack, or their next Line or Ranged Blast attack becomes a single target Ranged attack. If this attack hits, the target becomes [[status:Vulnerable]] for one full round and has their Initiative set to 0 until the end of their next turn.
» 3 Momentum: Your Pokémon may act while ignoring the Confused, [[status:Rage]], [[status:Infatuation]], and Suppressed Volatile Status on their next turn as long as they attempt to attack a Tagged foe. May only be used once per Scene per Pokémon.

features.Name: Seize The Moment
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon would gain Momentum while already at 6 Momentum
features.Effect: Your Pokémon loses 6 Momentum, and then gains +1 Momentum. Your Pokémon may immediately make an attack as an [[keyword:Interrupt]], but this attack must target only a Tagged Foe. If the attack misses, it still deals damage as if it had the [[keyword:Smite]] keyword. If the attack hits, it's automatically a Critical Hit. If it would have already been a Critical Hit, your Pokémon gains Hit Points equal to half of its maximum Hit Points. May be used only once per Scene per Pokémon .

features.Name: Enduring Soul
features.Effect: You may add to your Pokémon's HP stat when they level up, ignoring Base Relation, and you do not need to "correct" Stats due to this inflated HP.

features.Name: Staying Power
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon Takes a Breather
features.Effect: Your Pokémon may "Take a Breather" even if it is Confused or Enraged, and it does not Trip or have to Shift away from enemies as part of the action. You may choose whether or not your Pokémon resets their Combat Stages to default.

features.Name: Shrug Off
features.Effect: Once per day, each of your Pokémon may spend a Shift Action to remove 1 Injury from themselves; this may also be activated as a Free Action whenever your Pokémon Take a Breather.

features.Name: Awareness
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Enduring Soul]], 3 Pokémon with a Defensive Ability
features.Effect: Your Pokémon add +2 to all Save Checks.

features.Name: Resilience
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon is hit by a Critical Hit or gains a Status Affliction (or both)
features.Effect: Your Pokémon does not gain a Status Affliction, and the triggering attack does damage as if it was not a Critical Hit. [[feature:Resilience]] may only be used once per target per Scene.

features.Name: Not Yet!
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon is [[status:Fainted]], but is not at less than -100% Hit Points.
features.Effect: Before fainting, the targeted Pokémon gains an Injury, and may then use a Move as an [[keyword:Interrupt]]. When the Move is resolved, the Pokémon then immediately faints. This consumes a Pokémon turn as normal. This cannot be used with the Moves [[move:Explosion]], [[move:Pain Split]], or [[move:Self-Destruct]].

features.Name: Vim and Vigor
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon with at least 2 Tutor Points
features.Effect: The target loses 2 Tutor Points, and gains the [[ability:Vigor]] Ability.

features.Name: Juggler
features.Effect: Using [[feature:Quick Switch]] costs only 1 AP. Whenever you send a Pokémon into an encounter from a Poké Ball, they receive a +10 bonus to their Initiative during that round.

features.Name: Bounce Shot
features.Trigger: You throw a Poké Ball
features.Effect: After hitting its mark or landing, your Poké Ball bounces 3 meters in any direction. You may have your Poké Ball trigger captures or releases before or after the bounce.

features.Name: Juggling Show
features.Effect: You may roll an additional Xd6 during the Introduction Stage of a Contest, where X is half of your Acrobatics Rank. You may choose any Contest Stat to attempt to gain Dice for with this roll.

features.Name: Round Trip
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon uses a Move.
features.Effect: You may immediately switch your Pokémon that just performed a Move for another of your Pokémon. This effect lets Pokémon with the [[status:Trapped]] condition switch out.

features.Name: Tag In
features.Trigger: You recall a Pokémon
features.Effect: The next Pokémon you send out is treated as if the recalled Pokémon had used [[move:Baton Pass]] on it.

features.Name: Emergency Release
features.Effect: You may Release a Pokémon as an [[keyword:Interrupt]].

features.Name: First Blood
features.Trigger: You release a Pokémon from its Poké Ball
features.Effect: If you have a Pokémon turn available this round or next, your Pokémon may use a Move as an [[keyword:Interrupt]] as soon as it is sent out. This consumes your Pokémon turn for the round (or the following round) as normal.

features.Name: Rider
features.Prerequisites: [[edge:Mounted Prowess]], [[feature:Agility Training]], Novice Acrobatics or Athletics
features.Effect: While you are Mounted on a Pokemon under the effects of [[feature:Agility Training]], the bonuses from [[feature:Agility Training]] are doubled.

features.Name: Ramming Speed
features.Target: Your Pokémon with at least 2 Tutor Points
features.Effect: The target loses 2 Tutor Points and gains the Run Up Ability.

features.Name: Conqueror's March
features.Target: Your Pokémon with Run Up
features.Effect: This round, if being used as a Mount, the target may use [[keyword:Dash]], Burst, Blast, Cone, or Line range Moves with a range of [[keyword:Pass]] instead of their usual range.

features.Name: Ride as One
features.Effect: While you are Mounted, you and your Mount each use the highest of each other's Speed Evasion. If both you and your Mount have the same Speed Evasion, you instead each receive a +1 bonus to Speed Evasion. Whenever one of you receives Initiative, either of you may take your turn. When the next person would receive initiative, the person that did not take their turn then takes it.

features.Name: Lean In
features.Trigger: You and your Mount both take Damage from a Burst, Blast, Cone, or Line
features.Effect: Both you and your Mount Resist the attack one step further.

features.Name: Cavalier's Reprisal
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Ride as One]], Expert Acrobatics or Athletics
features.Trigger: An adjacent foe hits your Mount with an attack
features.Effect: You may make a Struggle Attack against the triggering foe.

features.Name: Overrun
features.Trigger: Your Mount with Run Up makes a Damage Roll for a [[keyword:Dash]] or [[keyword:Pass]] Move
features.Effect: Your Pokémon adds their Speed Stat in addition to their normal attacking Stat to their Damage Roll. The target gains Damage Reduction against this attack equal to their own Speed Stat.

features.Name: Taskmaster
features.Trigger: You apply [[feature:Brutal Training]] as a Training action
features.Effect: You may grant your Pokémon up to three injuries. If your Pokémon has at least one Injury, it becomes Hardened.

features.Name: Quick Healing
features.Effect: Your Hardened Pokémon may use [[feature:Quick Healing]] to remove up to three injuries, and gains two Ticks of Hit Points for each Injury removed this way.
features.Note: The Injury Removal from this Feature counts as Natural Healing, and thus counts against the total number of Injuries that can be removed in a day.

features.Name: Savage Strike
features.Target: Your Pokémon with at least 2 Tutor Points
features.Effect: The target loses 2 Tutor Points, and gains the [[ability:Cruelty]] Ability.

features.Name: Strike of the Whip
features.Trigger: You use [[feature:Press]]
features.Effect:
You may apply 1 or more of the following effects to the Pokémon hit by [[feature:Press]]:
» Give the target 1 Injury and a Tick of Temporary Hit Points.
» Spend 1 AP and cure the target of [[status:Confusion]], [[status:Infatuation]], [[status:Rage]], and Suppression.
» Use an [Order] you know with targets on the target as a Free Action.

features.Name: Pain Resistance
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon with 1 or more injuries takes Damage
features.Effect: Your Pokémon gains X Damage Reduction against the triggering attack, where X is its Tick Value multiplied by the number of Injuries it has. This may be triggered once per Scene per Pokémon.

features.Name: Press On!
features.Effect:
Your Hardened Pokemon gain the following benefits, based on your Intimidate Rank
» Expert: When your Pokemon Faints, you may pay 1 AP. If you do, your Pokemon Faints at -30% Hit Points instead.
» Master: While acting at 0 Hit Points or less, your Pokemon's Critical Hit, Effect Range, Evasion, Initiative, Damage Reduction, and Resistance Bonuses from being Hardened are doubled.
features.Note: Pokémon cannot use the Moves [[move:Explosion]], [[move:Endure]], [[move:Pain Split]], or [[move:Self-Destruct]] while they have 0 Hit Points or less. Pokémon with the [[capability:Soulless]] capability cannot benefit from [[feature:Press On!]]

features.Name: Desperate Strike
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon triggers [[ability:Cruelty]], or scores a Critical Hit with damaging attack.
features.Effect: Your Pokemon may apply the effects of [[ability:Cruelty]] to the attack without expending [[ability:Cruelty]]'s Frequency. [[ability:Cruelty]]'s effects may be purchased as if the foe had additional injuries equal to the number of injuries on the user. [[feature:Desperate Strike]] may be used once per Scene per Pokémon.

features.Name: Deadly Gambit
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon is the target of a foe's damaging melee attack
features.Effect: The triggering attack automatically hits as if it was a Critical Hit. Before damage resolves, your Pokémon may use a 1-Target damaging attack on the foe making the triggering attack as an [[keyword:Interrupt]], Frequency allowing, and also automatically hits as a Critical Hit. Damage for both attacks then resolve at the same time.
features.Note: This effect bypasses immunity to Critical Hits on your own Pokémon, but not on the target. Though both attacks hit automatically and are Critical Hits, you may still roll to activate effects.

features.Name: Trickster
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon hits a foe with a Status-Class Move or a foe triggers your Pokémon's Hazard
features.Effect: After the Move is resolved, your Pokémon may perform a Dirty Trick or Manipulate Maneuver on that foe as a Free Action. The Maneuver automatically hits, but the target must be in range for the chosen Maneuver. Use your own Guile to resolve Manipulate Rolls.

features.Name: Bag of Tricks
features.Effect: You gain two [[feature:Trickster Techniques]] of your choice, found on the next page.

features.Name: Stacked Deck
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon hits a foe suffering from a Status Affliction or one of the other conditions in the table below
features.Effect: Choose a Status Affliction or condition the triggering target is suffering from; the target suffers an additional effect according to the table below. [[feature:Stacked Deck]] may only affect a foe once per Scene.

features.Effect: Pick another Pokémon or Trainer within 3 meters of the target of the attack. You may repeat the triggering attack against the target, with a -5 Damage penalty. Special: [[feature:Fairy Lights]] also provide mild lighting, comparable to a candle. As an extended action your Pokemon can control the lights individually, but they must stay within 6 meters of the Pokemon that created them.

features.Effect: Your Pokémon and all allies on the Field gain a +1 Bonus to all rolls for one full round.

features.Effect: While this Feature is bound, whenever the target uses a 1-Target Move with the [[keyword:Social]] Keyword or a Fairy-Type Status Move, the foe hit by the triggering Move becomes Infatuated with your Pokemon, and immediately Shifts towards your Pokemon, forfeiting their next Shift Action. This may affect a specific foe only once per Scene.

features.Name: Fairy Rite
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon creates [[feature:Fairy Lights]] as a Standard Action
features.Effect: Your Fairy-Type Pokémon may activate [[feature:Fairy Rite]] as a Standard Action to lose any number of Hit Points, up to a maximum equal to your Pokémon's Level, and heal an adjacent Ally by that many Hit Points. features.Effect: While your Pokémon is adjacent to a foe they Marked, that foe gains a -X penalty to Accuracy Rolls and a -10 penalty to Damage Rolls on attacks that do not target the Pokémon that Marked them. X is equal to half your Type-Linked Skill Rank.

All three of your Pokémon's Standard Actions this turn must be used to perform [[feature:Zephyr Shield]], or Flying-Type Moves with a Frequency of At-Will or EOT. features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Ghost Step]], Adept Intimidate or Occult Education
features.Target: Your Pokémon
features.Effect:

As a Standard Action during their turn, or as Free Action upon Fainting, the target may spend their Curse Tokens to apply conditions to a foe within 6 meters.
» 1 Curse Token: The target loses a Combat Stage of your choice.
» 2 Curse Tokens: The target becomes [[status:Cursed]].
» 3 Curse Tokens: The target becomes [[status:Suppressed]].
» 4 Curse Tokens: The target falls Asleep and gains [[status:Bad Sleep]].

features.Effect: Choose a Stat. The triggering foe loses a Tick of Hit Points and a Combat Stage in that Stat. Your Pokémon gains 1 Combat Stage in the chosen Stat, and a Tick of Temporary Hit Points.

features.Effect: The next Ghost-Type attack the target makes that turn gains the [[keyword:Smite]] keyword and can't be Intercepted or avoided in any way ([[ability:Dodge]], [[ability:Parry]], [[keyword:Shield]] Moves, etc).

features.Target: Your Pokémon

» As a Swift Action on their turn to increase their Defense or Special Defense by 1 Combat Stage.

features.Effect: The target is [[status:Frozen]], and has their Attack, Special Attack, and Speed Combat Stages lowered by 1 each. The target is automatically cured of the Frozen Condition after 1 full round. A foe may be affected by [[feature:Deep Cold]] only once per Scene.

features.Effect: The target loses 2 Tutor Points and learns [[ability:Last Chance]] (Poison) or [[ability:Type Strategist]] (Poison). You may target a Pokémon only once with [[feature:Type Ace]].

features.Name: Type Refresh
features.Target: Your Pokémon
features.Effect: The target regains one use of a Poison-Type Scene-Frequency Move, and refreshes the Frequency of all Poison-Type EOT-Frequency Moves. A Target can be affected by [[feature:Type Refresh]] only once per Scene.

features.Name: Move Sync
features.Target: Your Pokémon with at least 1 Tutor Point.
features.Effect: The target loses 1 Tutor Point. Pick a Move in the target's Move List. The picked move is now permanently Poison-Type, and may have different effects. See the Types Changes section (page 468) for more information and suggestions. A Pokémon may have only one Move-Sync'd Move in their Move List at a time; to Sync a new Move, the old Move must be forgotten.

features.Name: Potent Venom
features.Trigger: Your Poison-Type Pokémon inflicts Poison on a foe
features.Effect: The foe does not necessarily lose Special Defense Combat Stages from Poison; instead, they lose Combat Stages in the Combat Stat of your choice. Whenever the target loses Hit Points from Poison, they lose additional Hit Points equal to your Type-Linked Skill Rank.

features.Name: Debilitate
features.Target: Your Poison-Type Pokémon
features.Effect: While this Feature is Bound, when the target successfully hits a [[status:Poisoned]] or Blighted foe with a Poison-Type Move, the foe gains a -2 penalty to Accuracy Rolls and Evasion for one full round.

features.Name: Miasma
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon misses with a Poison-Type Move
features.Effect: Your Pokémon may use either [[move:Smokescreen]] or [[move:Poison Gas]] as if they were on their Move List. When used this way, these Moves ignore Frequency Limitations, and are used as a Ranged Blast 3, with the blast centered on the square targeted by the triggering attack. Poison-Type Pokémon are not negatively affected by Smoke Screens created this way. Your Pokémon may also trigger [[feature:Miasma]] deliberately as a Standard Action.

features.Name: Corrosive Blight
features.Trigger: Your Pokémon hits a foe with a Poison-Type Attack
features.Effect: The target gains the Blight Condition for one full round. Blighted targets lose a Tick of Hit Points upon being hit by any attack. If the attack is Poison-Typed, the Blight effect's duration is refreshed.

features.Name: Type Ace
features.Prerequisites: 2 Different Psychic-Type Pokémon, Novice Focus or Occult Education OR [[edge:Elemental Connection]] (Psychic), 1 Psychic-Type Pokémon, Novice Focus or Occult Education
features.Target: Your Pokémon with at least 2 Tutor Points remaining.
features.Effect: The target loses 2 Tutor Points and learns [[ability:Last Chance]] (Psychic) or [[ability:Type Strategist]] (Psychic). You may target a Pokémon only once with [[feature:Type Ace]].
