» [[move:Baby-Doll Eyes]]: The target becomes Infatuated with you for the rest of the Scene, and cannot be cured of this condition by any means, including Taking a Breather. This does not bypass immunity to [[status:Infatuation]].
» [[move:Confide]]: You choose a Move the target has used this Scene. That Move becomes [[status:Disabled]] for the target.
» [[move:Leer]]: The target's Defense is lowered an additional Combat Stage, and their Special Defense is lowered by 2 Combat Stages.
» [[move:Sweet Kiss]]: While the target is Confused, they may not perform Disengage Maneuvers, and whenever they hit themselves in [[status:Confusion]], they provoke an Attack of Opportunity from all of their adjacent foes.
» [[move:Taunt]]: For 1 full round, the next damaging attack to hit the target of [[move:Taunt]] deals +3d8+10 Damage.
» [[move:Torment]]: The target's Ability is disabled until the end of the encounter. If the target has more than one Ability, you choose one of them to disable.
» [[move:Lovely Kiss]]: The target's Evasion is lowered by 2 for the rest of the Scene.

features.Name: Enchanting Gaze
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Quick Wit]], two Provocateur Skills at Expert Rank
features.Effect: Choose a Manipulate Maneuver effect; apply that Effect to all foes in a Cone 2. This ignores Frequency Limitations with that Maneuver and automatically succeeds against all targets without an opposed roll.

features.Name: Rogue
features.Prerequisites: Two of Acrobatics, Athletics, and Stealth at Novice Rank
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Feint Attack]] and [[move:Thief]].
features.Note: Acrobatics, Athletics, and Stealth are referred to as "Rogue Skills" as short-hand.

features.Name: Cutthroat
features.Effect: You may use [[feature:Rogue]] Moves as Weapon Moves when wielding Small Melee Weapons or Short Ranged Weapons. If you do, [[feature:Rogue]] Moves instead have the same Range as your Weapon. Additionally, you may qualify for Weapon Moves for Small Melee or Short Ranged Weapons and resist Disarm Maneuvers when wielding such Weapons using any Rogue Skill.

features.Name: Dirty Fighting
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Rogue]], a Rogue Skill at Adept Rank
features.Trigger: You hit a foe with Weapon Attack
features.Effect: After the attack is Resolved, you may immediately use the Dirty Trick Maneuver if the target is within range. You automatically hit with Dirty Trick, but must still make an Opposed Roll.

features.Name: Unexpected Attacks
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Rogue]], two Rogue Skills at Adept Rank
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Pursuit]] and [[move:Sucker Punch]].

features.Name: Underhanded Tactics
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Rogue]], a Rogue Skill at Expert Rank
features.Effect: You gain your choice of [[ability:Ambush]] or [[ability:Cruelty]].

features.Name: Street Fighter
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Unexpected Attacks]], two Rogue Skills at Expert Rank
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Assurance]] and [[move:Payback]].

features.Name: Scoundrel's Strike
features.Trigger: You hit with a [[feature:Rogue]] Move
features.Effect:
The target loses Hit Points equal to your highest Rogue Skill Rank doubled, and an additional effect based on whether you have the [[ability:Ambush]] or [[ability:Cruelty]] Ability. You may use [[feature:Scoundrel's Strike]] only once per Scene per target.
» [[ability:Ambush]]: For 1 Full Round, the target is [[status:Slowed]], cannot make Attacks of Opportunity, and takes a -2 penalty to all rolls.
» [[ability:Cruelty]]: For 1 Full Round, the target loses 5 Hit Points upon being hit by any damaging attack.

features.Name: Roughneck
features.Trigger: You hit a foe with an Attack
features.Effect: The foe loses a Combat Stage in the Stat of your choice.

features.Name: Menace
features.Trigger: You hit a foe with the Terrorize Manipulation
features.Effect: Until their next turn, the target has their Initiative lowered to 0. For one full round, attacks against them cause them to [[status:Flinch]] on 17+ or have their existing Flinch Range increased by +4.

features.Name: Mettle
features.Target: You take Massive Damage or Intercept a Damaging Attack.
features.Effect: Resolve Damage as if the triggering attack was resisted one step. The triggering foe then loses 2 Combat Stages in the Attack Stat used by the triggering Attack.

features.Name: Malice
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Mean Look]] and [[move:Chip Away]].

features.Name: Fearsome Display
features.Trigger: You use [[move:Leer]] or a [[feature:Roughneck]] Move
features.Effect:
The Move gains additional effects.
» [[move:Leer]]: Attacks against affected foes gain a +2 Bonus to their Critical Range for one full round.
» [[move:Chip Away]]: The target is considered [[status:Vulnerable]] against this attack.
» [[move:Headbutt]]: The target has their Initiative set to 0 until the end of their next turn.
» [[move:Glare]]: The target loses 2 Speed Combat Stages. This occurs whether [[move:Glare]] hits or misses.
» [[move:Mean Look]]: The target is [[status:Suppressed]].
» [[move:Endure]]: You gain two Ticks of Temporary Hit Points.
» [[move:Slack Off]]: You are cured of one Status Affliction.

features.Name: Cruel Gaze
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Glare]] and [[move:Headbutt]].

features.Name: Tough as Nails
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Endure]] and [[move:Slack Off]].

features.Name: Tumbler
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Run Away]] Ability.

features.Name: Aerialist
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Aerial Ace]] and [[move:Splash]].

features.Name: Quick Gymnastics
features.Trigger: You hit with an Attack; you make a Jump; or you stand up from being [[status:Tripped]]
features.Effect: You may may Shift 2 Meters. You don't count as Flanked or trigger Attacks of Opportunity until the end of your next turn. Additionally, if you activate this Feature, the triggering action does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

features.Name: Flip Out
features.Effect:
Your Tumbler Moves gain additional effects.
» [[move:Aerial Ace]]: If you choose not to test for a Critical Hit, [[move:Aerial Ace]] gains the [[keyword:Pass]] Keyword.
» [[move:Splash]]: Once a Scene, you may use [[move:Splash]] as if it had the [[keyword:Interrupt]] keyword upon getting hit with an attack. If you do, you gain Damage Reduction against that attack equal to twice your Acrobatics Rank.
» [[move:Acrobatics]]: You may activate [[move:Acrobatics]]'s extra damage even while holding an Item.
» [[move:Bounce]]: When you use [[move:Bounce]], you don't trigger Hazards that turn and may choose to destroy all Hazards in your landing square and adjacent squares.

features.Name: Death From Above
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Acrobatics]] and [[move:Bounce]].

features.Name: Quick Reflexes
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Dodge]] Ability.

features.Name: Burst of Speed
features.Trigger: You end your turn
features.Effect: Select an Initiative Count equal to half of your own Initiative or less; you may take an extra turn at that point in the round.

features.Name: Aura Guardian
features.Effect: Choose two of [[move:Detect]], [[move:Vacuum Wave]], or [[move:Force Palm]]. You learn the chosen Moves.

features.Name: Aura Reader
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Aura Reader]] Capability for the rest of the scene. If your Intuition is Adept Rank or higher, you also gain the [[capability:Aura Pulse]] Capability.

features.Name: The Power of Aura
features.Effect: Each Rank, choose [[ability:Scrappy]] or [[ability:Aura Storm]]. You gain the Chosen Ability.

features.Name: Sword of Body and Soul
features.Trigger: You use a damaging [[feature:Aura Guardian]] Move against an adjacent foe
features.Effect: You may have the triggering Move deal damage as if it was your choice of Physical or Special Classes. Regardless, add both your Attack and Special Attack Stats to the Damage Roll, and this attack ignores Damage Reduction. This does not stack with [[ability:Twisted Power]].

features.Name: Ambient Aura
features.Trigger: You use a Move with the [[keyword:Aura]] keyword
features.Effect:
You gain an Aura Blessing that can be spent any time as a Free Action Interrupt. When you spend an Aura Blessing, you choose one of the effects below. You may only have one Aura Blessing at a time, and you must have the [[capability:Aura Pulse]] Capability to use [[feature:Ambient Aura]].
» You create an energy barrier around you or an ally within 5 meters granting Damage Reduction equal to your Intuition Rank tripled until the end of your next turn.
» You cure yourself of a Volatile Status Affliction.
» Gain the [[capability:Blindsense]] Capability until the end of the Scene.

features.Name: Aura Mastery
features.Effect: Choose two of [[move:Aura Sphere]], [[move:Focus Blast]], [[move:Drain Punch]], or [[move:Focus Punch]]. You learn the chosen Moves.

features.Name: Channeler
features.Target: A Pokémon.
features.Effect: You Channel the target Pokémon. If you attempt to Channel a Hostile Pokémon, you must make an Intuition Check with a DC of 15 to Channel the target. You may stop Channeling a Pokémon as a Free Action at any time. You may Channel a number of Pokémon at a time up to your Intuition Rank. If a Channeled Pokémon goes further than 20 meters from you, they stop being Channeled.
features.Mecanic: While Channeling a Pokémon, it may communicate its intentions, emotions, and motivations to you and you may communicate similarly with them; neither party may be deceitful in this exchange. You also become aware of all of its Moves, Abilities, and Capabilities. Allied Channeled Pokémon may always attempt Intercept Maneuvers for each other, regardless of Loyalty. If you are [[status:Fainted]], you stop Channeling all Pokémon. Whenever you Channel a Pokémon, you have a vague knowledge of what has happened in the Pokémon’s past hour as if they were your own memories.
features.Note: [[feature:Channeler]] has a couple Features with the [Orders] tag. However, because they require that a Pokémon be Channeled, which isn’t League Legal, they actually aren’t of any use in League Legal battles!

features.Name: Shared Senses
features.Target: A Channeled Pokémon
features.Effect: You Imprint the target for the duration of this Feature. You receive all sensory information being sensed by Imprinted Pokémon, and Imprinted Pokémon are not subject to the distance limit on Channeling. If you have Imprinted more than one Pokémon, you may only concentrate on the senses of one Pokémon at a time, and only choose one such Pokémon per round. If you stop Channeling a Pokémon, they are no longer Imprinted as well.

features.Name: Battle Synchronization
features.Effect: For one full round, whenever a Channeled Pokémon successfully hits a foe, all Channeled Pokémon gain +1 Accuracy and +1 Evasion against that foe for the duration of this Feature.

features.Name: Spirit Boost
features.Effect:
When you use [[feature:Spirit Boost]], choose a Channeled Pokémon. You may choose the target of [[feature:Spirit Boost]] if you wish. While [[feature:Spirit Boost]] is Bound, the target has one of the following effects, depending on the highest Combat Stat of the chosen Pokémon. (In the event of a tie, you choose which Stat to use)
Attack: The target gains Bonus Damage when using Physical attacks equal to your Intuition Rank.
Defense: The target gains Damage Reduction against Physical attacks equal to your Intuition Rank.
Special Attack: The target gains gain Bonus Damage when using Special attacks equal to your Intuition Rank.
Special Defense: The target gains Damage Reduction against Special attacks equal to your Intuition Rank.
Speed: The target gains a bonus to their Initiative equal to your Intuition Rank.

features.Name: Power Conduit
features.Target: Channeled Pokémon
features.Effect:
Choose One:
» Trade all Combat Stages for a single Stat between two Channeled Pokémon
» Transfer a [[keyword:Coat]] from one Channeled Pokémon to another.
» Give up a use of Scene or Daily Move from one willing Channeled Pokémon to regain use of a Scene Move which another Channeled Pokémon has used. This effect may only refresh a Move for each Pokémon once per Scene.

features.Name: Pain Dampening
features.Target: A Channeled Pokémon would be [[status:Fainted]] by a damaging attack
features.Effect: Choose any number of Channeled Pokémon, which must include the triggering Pokémon. Instead of resolving the attack normally, divide the damage from the attack by the number of chosen Pokémon. Each chosen Pokémon then loses that many Hit Points. For each chosen Pokémon that Resists or is Immune to the Type of the triggering attack, subtract your Intuition Rank from the damage of the attack before all calculations.

features.Name: Soothing Connection
features.Target: Channeled Pokémon
features.Effect: Distribute 5 points in any way among Pokémon you are Channeling. For each point you assign to a Channeled Pokémon, they gain a Tick of Hit Points.

features.Name: Hex Maniac
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Cursed Body]] or [[ability:Omen]]. You gain the Chosen Ability.

features.Name: Hex Maniac Studies
features.Effect:
Learn two [[feature:Hex Maniac]] Moves. You may choose any Move marked with the [[feature:Hex Maniac Studies]] Rank you are taking or lower.
*Note: When using [[move:Curse]], you must use [[move:Curse]] as if you were a Ghost-Type Pokémon.

features.Name: Diffuse Pain
features.Trigger: You use a Status-Class Move gained from [[feature:Hex Maniac Studies]]
features.Effect: Choose an additional target for the Move.

features.Name: Malediction
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Hex Maniac Studies]] Rank 1, Expert Occult Education
features.Trigger: A foe within 5 meters misses all targets with an attack
features.Effect: Use a Status-Class Move gained from [[feature:Hex Maniac Studies]] targeting the triggering foe as a Free Action, Frequency-permitting.

features.Name: Grand Hex
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Hex Maniac Studies]] Rank 3, Master Occult Education
features.Trigger: You hit a foe with [[move:Hex]]
features.Effect: Regain one use of a Move gained from [[feature:Hex Maniac Studies]] that can inflict a Status Affliction that the triggering target has. If you activated the conditional damage boost for [[move:Hex]], its Frequency is not expended. You may only activate [[feature:Grand Hex]] once per target per Scene.

features.Name: Ninja
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Double Team]] and [[move:Poison Powder]].

features.Name: Ninja's Arsenal
features.Effect: You may craft an [[item:Antidote]], [[item:Smoke Ball]], Caltrops, or Toxic Caltrops for ₽100.

features.Name: Poison Weapons
features.Trigger: You make a Weapon Attack.
features.Effect: The attack or Move Poisons its targets on 16+, and you may have it deal Poison-Type Damage if you wish.

features.Name: Genjutsu
features.Effect: You form an Illusion around yourself. This Illusion may be used to hide yourself in a shroud of darkness if in darkness, or to make yourself look like a mundane object (such as a crate, potted plant, or similar). The Illusion can even fool [[keyword:Aura]], concealing you from Aura Sight for its duration. However, the Illusion requires complete concentration, and is broken if you take any actions at all. Anyone that interacts with the Illusion directly may make an Occult Education or Intuition Check with a DC equal to 10 plus your Stealth Rank; if they succeed, the Illusion is broken.

features.Name: Utility Drop
features.Trigger: You Shift
features.Effect: You may use a [[item:Smoke Ball]], Caltrops, or Toxic Caltrops as a Free action during your Shift. Instead of the Move's usual area of effect, you leave one square of [[move:Smokescreen]], [[move:Spikes]], or [[move:Toxic Spikes]] on each square you leave as you Shift. Once you place 8 meters of Smoke, [[move:Spikes]], or [[move:Toxic Spikes]] you may not place any more.

features.Name: Weightless Step
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Infiltrator]] Ability.

features.Name: Kinjutsu
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Substitute]] and [[move:Toxic]].

features.Name: Oracle
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Pickup]] Ability.

features.Name: Divination
features.Effect: You may perform an [[feature:Augury]] or [[feature:Scrying]].

techniques.Name: Augury
techniques.Effect: The user has a vision, dream, or similar that may depict past, present, or future events. The clarity of the dream may vary, as well as the user's ability to remember it. See the next page for more details (p.187).

techniques.Name: Scrying
techniques.Target: An item you are touching, or your current location
techniques.Effect: You see visions of what has happened to the target over the last 24 hours. The images may be jumbled or unclear, to the discretion of your GM. See the next page for more details (p.187).

features.Name: Unveiled Sight
features.Effect: You can see through Illusions. This means you can spot Illusions from the [[capability:Illusionist]] capability, [[ability:Illusion]] Ability, and [[feature:Genjutsu]] Feature as being fake. You are immune to Moves with the [[keyword:Illusion]] keyword, [[move:Double Team]] cannot be activated against you, and you bypass Substitutes. As a Standard Action, you can create a Burst 4, dispelling all Illusion effects within.

features.Name: Small Prophecies
features.Effect: Roll 1d20 and note the result. Until the end of your next turn, you may choose to replace a single d20 roll you or a willing ally makes with the noted result.

features.Name: Mark of Vision
features.Target: A willing Trainer
features.Effect: You mark the target with a mystical power which allows you to close your eyes and focus to perceive the world with their senses from their perspective. You may Bind this Ability multiple times, each time on a different target, but you may only concentrate on one [[feature:Mark of Vision]] at a time, and you may only have a number of Marks at one time equal to half your Perception Rank. A target may choose to end this effect at any time, or to deny you access to their senses temporarily without ending the effect entirely. You have a rough sense of how far away and in what direction marked targets are.

features.Name: Two-Second Preview
features.Effect: You gain the Instinct Ability.

features.Name: Prescience
features.Trigger: You are hit by an attack
features.Effect: The attack instead misses.

features.Name: Sage
features.Target: An ally within 5 meters
features.Effect: The target gains Damage Reduction equal to your Occult Education Rank doubled or their Tick Value, whichever is higher, for one full round. Multiple uses of [[feature:Sage]] from different Trainers do not stack on one target.

features.Name: Sacred Shield
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Reflect]] and [[move:Lucky Chant]].

features.Name: Mystic Defense
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Light Screen]] and [[move:Safeguard]].

features.Name: Sage's Benediction
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Sacred Shield]] or [[feature:Mystic Defense]], Adept Occult Education
features.Target: An ally activates one of your Moves with the [[keyword:Blessing]] Keyword.
features.Effect:
The triggering ally gains an additional benefit as follows, depending on the Move used. The benefit takes effect after the [[keyword:Blessing]] and the attack that triggered it are resolved.
» [[move:Reflect]]: +1 Defense Combat Stage
» [[move:Light Screen]]: +1 Sp. Defense Combat Stage
» [[move:Safeguard]]: +1 Evasion
» [[move:Lucky Chant]]: +1 Accuracy.

features.Name: Lay on Hands
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Blessed Touch]] or [[ability:Healer]]. You gain the Chosen Ability.

features.Name: Highly Responsive to Prayers
features.Trigger: You use the [[ability:Blessed Touch]] or [[ability:Healer]] Ability on an ally, or an ally receives an Injury
features.Effect: You may use the [[feature:Sage]] Feature as a Free Action targeting the triggering ally. Multiple instances of [[feature:Sage]]'s effect that you use may stack when used this way.

features.Name: Divine Wind
features.Target: Blessings you generated with a [[feature:Sage]] Move
features.Effect: Choose a type of [[keyword:Blessing]] you can generate with a [[feature:Sage]] Move. All Blessings you generated of another type become Blessings of the chosen type. This may not be used to generate more uses of a [[keyword:Blessing]] than the original Move creates. For example, three [[move:Lucky Chant]] Blessings would become two [[move:Reflect]] or [[move:Light Screen]] Blessings, not three. You may only choose a [[keyword:Blessing]] type once per Scene.

features.Name: Telekinetic
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Telekinetic]] Capability.

features.Name: PK Alpha
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Kinesis]] and [[move:Barrier]].

features.Name: PK Omega
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Telekinesis]] and Psychic.

features.Name: Power of the Mind
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Interference]] or [[ability:Levitate]]. You gain the chosen Ability.

features.Name: PK Combat
features.Effect: You may also wield weapons and items with your [[move:Telekinesis]] capability, as long as you are able to lift them. This means you may use Items and Melee Weapons that normally require you to be adjacent to your target at a range limited only by your [[move:Telekinesis]]. When wielding Weapons with your [[move:Telekinesis]], you qualify for Moves using Focus instead of Combat and may add your Special Attack instead of your Attack Stat. The Attacks remain Physical, however.

features.Name: Telekinetic Burst
features.Effect: You perform a Disarm, Trip, or Push Maneuver using your [[capability:Telekinetic]] Capability.

features.Name: Psionic Overload
features.Trigger: You hit with Psychic or use another Telekinetic Move
features.Effect:
The effect of this Feature depends on the Triggering Move.
» [[move:Kinesis]]: The user of the triggering attack becomes Confused.
» [[move:Barrier]]: Place 2 additional segments of [[move:Barrier]], and you may place the Barriers anywhere within 6 meters of yourself. They do not need to remain contiguous, nor does one segment have to touch you.
» Psychic: The target becomes [[status:Vulnerable]] for one full round.
» [[move:Telekinesis]]: At the end of each turn that the target remains Lifted, they lose a Tick of Hit Points.

features.Name: Telepath
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Telepathy]] Capability for the rest of the scene.

features.Name: Honed Mind
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Mind Reader]] and [[move:Calm Mind]].

features.Name: Telepathic Awareness
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Gentle Vibe]] or [[ability:Telepathy]]. You gain the chosen Ability.

features.Name: Thought Detection
features.Effect: You become aware of the number of living Humans or Pokémon within X meters of yourself; X is equal to your Focus Rank tripled. Pokémon or Trainers with the [[capability:Mindlock]] Capability are not detected by this Ability. You may only use [[feature:Thought Detection]] as long as you have the [[ability:Telepathy]] Capability.

features.Name: Telepathic Warning
features.Trigger: You or an Ally use an Attack
features.Effect: You're able to give your allies heed of attacks. All allies that would be hit by the attack may take a Shift Action as an [[keyword:Interrupt]] to move out of the area of effect of the attack. Using this leaves discoverable Psychic Residue on each affected ally. You may only use [[feature:Telepathic Warning]] as long as you have the [[capability:Telepath]] Capability.

features.Name: Mental Assault
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Extrasensory]] and [[move:Psyshock]].

features.Name: Suggestion
features.Target: Pokémon or Trainers
features.Effect: You smoothly plant a thought into the subject's head that lasts as long as this Feature is Bound. They won't know exactly why or how they thought of it; they will naturally assume they thought of it themselves, and their brain will attempt to get there as logically as it can. The target may not necessarily act on the [[feature:Suggestion]], especially if it is against their nature. Using Suggestion to plant a specific thought may cause the target to think about a specific subject, dredging up surface thoughts related to the matter. Using this on a target leaves discoverable psychic residue. You may only use [[feature:Suggestion]] as long as you have the [[ability:Telepathy]] Capability, though you may keep it Bound without having [[ability:Telepathy]] active.

features.Name: Warper
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Probability Control]] Ability.

features.Name: Space Distortion
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Teleport]] and [[move:Ally Switch]].

features.Name: Warping Ground
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Gravity]] and [[move:Trick]].

features.Name: Strange Energy
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Heal Block]] and [[move:Magic Coat]].

features.Name: Farcast
features.Trigger: You use the Move [[move:Teleport]] or activate the Teleporter Capability
features.Effect: Choose One: You activate Teleporter as if your Teleporter value were three times its normal value or you may take one willing Pokémon or Trainer along with you as you teleport so long as you are touching them when you activate [[feature:Farcast]]. You may expend two uses of [[feature:Farcast]] at once to choose both effects.

features.Name: Warped Transmission
features.Trigger: You activate the Teleporter Capability or use the Move [[move:Ally Switch]]
features.Effect: All adjacent foes to the square you end in after teleporting or using [[move:Ally Switch]] have their Evasion lowered by 3 for one full round and cannot trigger Attacks of Opportunity against you for Shifting until the end of your next turn.

features.Name: Reality Bender
features.Effect: You are able to subconsciously alter the fabric of reality to change small facts or circumstances. If your character is confronting a "random" event such as a die roll, coin flip, or cards being dealt, the character may activate this Feature to influence the event. In this scenario, the GM provides you with two possible outcomes, and you pick one of them to actually occur. This means you always decide the outcome of binary events such as a coin flip; cheating cards or slot machines is much harder, as there are multiple outcomes and you only get to pick between two. This Feature can also be used to generate common items worth ₽250 or less that the character might normally possess, such as a [[item:Potion]] or Poké Ball, when in a pinch. The character just happens to find the needed item among their belongings. This Feature can only create items you wish to use at that moment, and of which you have none available; such as needing to heal a Pokémon but having no Potions left. Items created with [[feature:Reality Bender]] must be used quickly after activating the feature and cannot be stored for later.

features.Name: Backpacker
features.Effect: You gain the [[edge:Skill Enhancement]] Edge. You then gain an instance of the [[edge:Skill Stunt]] Edge for each of the two Skills you chose with [[edge:Skill Enhancement]].

features.Name: Item Mastery
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Fling]] and [[move:Recycle]].

features.Name: Equipment Savant
features.Effect: Use or Equip an Item or piece of Equipment which would normally require a Standard Action to use or equip. You may not make an Attack with a Weapon this way  - using other Items or Equipment that requires "Attacks" (such as Cap Cannons or Poké Balls) is acceptable.

features.Name: Hero's Journey
features.Effect: Each Rank, you may gain two [[feature:Backpacker Talents]] for which you qualify.

talents.Name: Call to Adventure
talents.Effect: You gain the [[edge:Instinctive Aptitude]] Edge, even if you do not meet its prerequisites. If you already have this Edge, gain another Edge for which you qualify. During Combat or tense situations (never Extended Actions), if you spend AP to add a bonus to a Skill Check, you may add +1d6 instead of +2.

talents.Name: Frisk
talents.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Frisk]] Ability.

talents.Name: Handyman
talents.Effect: Whenever you use an item or a non-Weapon piece of equipment which calls for a Skill Check or has an effect or prerequisite based on a Skill Rank, you may substitute Survival for the used Skill. This does not affect prerequisites for Books.

talents.Name: Hat Trick
talents.Effect: While wearing Head Equipment worth at least ₽1000, you gain 15 Damage Reduction against Critical Hits. This does not stack with any Damage Reduction granted by any Head Equipment.

talents.Name: Movement Mastery
talents.Effect: Choose one of [[edge:Art of Stealth]], [[edge:Athletic Initiative]], [[edge:Mounted Prowess]], [[edge:Nimble Movement]], [[edge:Slippery]], [[edge:Stamina]], [[edge:Swimmer]], or [[edge:Wallrunner]]. You gain the chosen Edge, even if you do not meet the prerequisites. Additionally, you may take any of these Edges in the future as if you did meet the prerequisites.

talents.Name: Sole Power
talents.Effect: While wearing Feet Equipment worth at least ₽1000, you do not trigger Hazards while Shifting. However, you still trigger any Hazards that you are standing on at the start or end of your turn. Reactive Hazards such as [[move:Stealth Rock]] cannot be triggered against you.

talents.Name: Wayfarer
talents.Effect: You may use your Survival Skill when making Opposed Rolls when defending against Disarm, Grapple, [[keyword:Push]], and Trip Maneuvers. When wielding a Weapon, you may use Survival instead of Combat to determine the Damage Base of your Struggle Attacks and to qualify for a Weapon's Moves.

talents.Name: Wear it Better
talents.Effect: While wearing Body Equipment worth at least ₽1000, you gain +5 Damage Reduction. This does not stack with any Damage Reduction granted by any Body Equipment.

features.Name: Medic
features.Effect: You are always considered to have access to a [[item:First Aid Manual]] and a [[item:Combat Medic's Primer]], and are always considered to be Binding their Rank 1 Effects without actually using any AP.

features.Name: Front Line Healer
features.Effect: When you apply a Restorative, you gain +5 Damage Reduction for 1 full round. Whenever you use [[item:Combat Medic's Primer]]'s Rank 2 effect, you may apply the same effect on yourself. Damage Reduction from this Feature does not stack with itself.

features.Name: Medical Techniques
features.Trigger: You apply a Restorative Item
features.Effect: The target of the triggering action gains a Tick of Hit Points, plus an additional amount of Hit Points equal to your Medicine Education Rank.

features.Name: I'm a Doctor
features.Effect: Each Rank, you gain one of [[edge:Field Clinic]] or [[edge:Medic Training]] and one of [[feature:Nurse]] or [[feature:First Aid Expertise]].

features.Name: Proper Care
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:I'm a Doctor]], [[edge:Field Clinic]], Expert Medicine Education
features.Effect:
You gain additional bonuses to using Restoratives and Features while in a Field Clinic, Poke Center, Hospital, or other dedicated healing space that lets you access supplies.
» When you trigger [[feature:First Aid Expertise]] here, the injury that is Removed does not count towards the total number of Injuries that may be removed each day.
» When you trigger [[feature:Nurse]] here, [[item:Bandages]] cure 1 Injury after three hours, in addition the injury healed after 6 hours.
» All Restoratives heal an additional 5 Hit Points. This stacks with the bonus granted by [[edge:Field Clinic]].

features.Name: Stay With Us!
features.Trigger: An Ally is hit by an attack
features.Effect: You must be able to Shift to your target to use this Feature. If you can, you immediately do so, and may apply a [[item:Potion]], [[item:Super Potion]], [[item:Hyper Potion]], [[item:Energy Powder]], or [[item:Energy Root]]. Though damage, injuries, and all other effects of the triggering attack are finalized before this Feature is applied, do not determine if the target has been [[status:Fainted]], Killed, or gained Injuries from Hit Point Markers until after the effects of the action chosen through use of this Feature has been resolved.

features.Name: Berserker
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Rage]] and [[move:Flail]]. You may use these moves as a Weapon Attack when wielding Melee Weapons.

features.Name: Power of Rage
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Enduring Rage]], or [[ability:White Flame]]. You gain the chosen Ability.

features.Name: Lessons In Rage and Pain
features.Effect: While you have at least 1 Injury, add +X to your Damage Rolls with [[move:Rage]], [[move:Flail]], [[move:Fury Swipes]], [[move:Thrash]], and Weapon Attacks. X is equal to your Intimidate Rank plus the number of Injuries you have. You do not lose Hit Points from being Heavily Injured, and Injuries beyond the 5th do not lower your Maximum Hit Points.

features.Name: Frenzy
features.Trigger: You must currently be Enraged to use this Feature Effect
features.Effect: You may immediately take your turn with [[keyword:Priority]]. If you do, you are instantly cured of [[status:Slowed]] and [[status:Stuck]], and for the rest of this turn gain a +2 Bonus to Critical Hit Range, +2 Bonus to Movement Speed, and +2 Bonus to Acrobatics, Athletics, Combat, and Intimidate Checks.

features.Name: Fight On and On
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Lessons In Rage and Pain]], Adept Combat
features.Trigger: Your Hit Points are lowered to or below 0 while Enraged.
features.Effect: You are not [[status:Fainted]]; you instead Faint upon reaching -50% of your Max Hit Points. If you have 5 or more injuries, you may use this Feature regardless of Frequency.

features.Name: Crash and Smash
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Double-Edge]] and [[move:Thrash]]. You may use these moves as a Weapon Attack when wielding Melee Weapons.

features.Name: Push it to the Limit
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Lessons In Rage and Pain]], Expert Intimidate
features.Trigger: You hit with a [[feature:Berserker]] Move or Weapon Attack
features.Effect: Immediately gain one Injury before resolving the triggering attack. You gain a Tick of Temporary Hit Points and may cure yourself of a Persistent Status Affliction. The triggering attack doubles your damage bonus from [[feature:Lessons In Rage and Pain]].

features.Name: Rune Master
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Gather Unown]] capability, and your Unown gain the [[capability:Letter Press]] Capability. When using [[capability:Gather Unown]], you are treated as a level 20 Pokémon.

features.Name: Hidden Power
features.Effect: You learn the Move [[move:Hidden Power]]. Whenever you use [[move:Hidden Power]], it may be either Physical or Special, adding the appropriate Attack Stat.

features.Name: Rewrite
features.Target: Self or a willing Pokémon with [[move:Hidden Power]].
features.Effect: Reroll the Type for an instance of [[move:Hidden Power]] the target knows If you target an Unown, you may transform the target into a different letter.

features.Name: Glyph
features.Target: Your Unown that is not part of a Prime Unown
features.Effect: You may set the target Unown against any flat surface, and turn the Unown into a glyph. Glyphs have HP equal to your Level, and no other stats. Glyphs last until they are destroyed or intentionally de-activated, at which time the Unown returns to Unown Space, disappearing forever. You may have a number of active Glyphs equal to your Occult Education Rank. When setting a [[feature:Glyph]], you may have the Glyphs be either visible or invisible, as you prefer. At any time, as a Standard Action, you may Channel any [[feature:Glyph]] youhave set down. This causes the [[feature:Glyph]]'s eye to open and become visible if it was not. While you are channeling a [[feature:Glyph]], you are able to see through the [[feature:Glyph]], listen through it, and project your voice through it.

features.Name: Words of Power
features.Trigger: You or your Pokémon use [[move:Hidden Power]]
features.Effect: Instead of a Burst, you may choose to have [[move:Hidden Power]] be a 1 Target Melee, 1 Target 6m, or Cone 2. Additionally, you and your Prime Unown always have STAB on [[move:Hidden Power]] as if you or they were of the same Type.

features.Name: Alarm Runes
features.Target: A Glyph you have put down, regardless of distance
features.Effect: You give the [[feature:Glyph]] a [[keyword:Trigger]], which may be as vague or as precise as you like (i.e.: "If anyone enters the room", "if James peeks in my diary", "If a Torkoal uses [[move:Surf]] while I scream the word 'Gelato'"). If the trigger is met within the Rune's 30 meters, the Rune will become visible, and will begin screeching loudly, alerting anyone nearby. You are capable of hearing this screeching noise in your head, regardless of your current distance. Glyphs will remember their Triggers as long as the AP spent on the Feature is Bound. If you have the [[feature:Explosive Runes]] or [[feature:Sentry Runes]] Features, you may instruct this [[feature:Glyph]] to automatically use the chosen Feature as a Free Action when it is triggered if you have the AP to spend. You may have only one [[feature:Glyph]] use [[feature:Explosive Runes]] per round, even if multiple Runes are triggered at the same time.

features.Name: Explosive Runes
features.Target: A Glyph you have put down, regardless of distance
features.Effect: You may use [[move:Hidden Power]], originating the attack from the location of the targeted [[feature:Glyph]]. Use your own Stats and [[move:Hidden Power]] values to calculate damage. Using this Feature causes the [[feature:Glyph]] to become visible and glow for a minute afterwards.

features.Name: Sentry Runes
features.Target: A Glyph you have put down, regardless of distance
features.Effect: The target [[feature:Glyph]] becomes an Unown of your Trainer Level, its Stats allocated as you wish. This Unown knows a single instance of [[move:Hidden Power]], identical to your own. The Glyph can fight on its own without needing you to command it. At the end of the encounter, or after 5 minutes, the Unown returns to Unown Space forever, destroying the [[feature:Glyph]]. You may only have one [[feature:Glyph]] active in this way at a time; if various Alarm Glyphs are triggered to become Sentries at the same time, only one does so; the others will do so once the previous one has been destroyed if the [[keyword:Trigger]] condition is still being met.

features.Name: Arcanist
features.Target: An Arcane Weapon
features.Effect:
You create a Soul Bond with the target Weapon. You may make a Soul Bond with only one weapon at a time. If you create a new Soul Bond, previously Soul Bound weapons lose the Bond. Soul Bound Weapons gain the following benefits:
» Increase the Damage Base and Effect Range of Struggle Attacks and Arcane Weapon Moves made with your Soul Bonded Weapon by +1 for each Occult Education Rank you have above Novice, up to a maximum of +3 at Master Rank.
» As a Shift Action, you may beckon your Soul Bonded Weapon to your hands if it is within 10 meters. If it is being held by someone else who does not want to let go of the weapon, make an Occult vs Athletics Opposed Check. If you win, they their lose grip on your Weapon and it flies to your hand as normal.

features.Name: Metamagic
features.Trigger: You use a Special Move
features.Effect: You may apply a Rank 1 Power Manipulation to your attack.

features.Name: Authentic Thaumaturgy
features.Trigger: You use a Special Move
features.Effect: You may apply a Rank 2 Power Manipulation to your attack.

features.Name: Signature Manipulations
features.Rank 1 Effect: Select a Rank 1 Power Manipulation. This Manipulation maybe used twice per Scene without spending AP to activate.
features.Rank 2 Effect: Select a Rank 1 Power Manipulation. This Manipulation maybe used twice per Scene without spending AP to activate. OR Select a Rank 2 power Manipulation. This Manipulation may be used once per Scene without activating [[feature:Authentic Thaumaturgy]]'s Frequency.

features.Name: Recoup Energy
features.Trigger: Your Special Move misses all targets
features.Effect: You do not expend the Frequency of the triggering Move. If you applied a Power Manipulation to the triggering Move, you are refunded the AP for the Manipulation or do not expend the Frequency for it.

features.Name: Soul Investment
features.Target: Your Soul Bonded Weapon
features.Effect: Choose one Novice and one Expert Arcane Weapon Move. Your Soul Bonded Weapon adds those Moves to your Move List as long as this Feature is Bound. You may only Bind one instance of this Feature at a time, and you may not have multiple instances of the same Move in your Move List.

techniques.Name: Energy Finesse
techniques.Condition: The triggering Move is an Arcane Weapon Move and has an Effect Range
techniques.Effect: In addition to its existing Effect Range, the Effect triggers on all natural Even-Numbered Rolls.

techniques.Name: Warp Energy
techniques.Condition: The triggering Move is a Cone, Line, Burst, or Blast
techniques.Effect: Instead of its usual range, you may use the Move as if it had a range of Burst 1, Cone 2, Close Blast 2, Line 4, or 2-Target with a range of 4.

techniques.Name: Directed Barrier
techniques.Effect: You gain Damage Reduction equal to your Tick Value against the targets of the triggering Move for one fullround.

techniques.Name: Power Overdrive
techniques.Effect: If the triggering attack hits, you lose a Tick of Hit Points, and the triggering attack deals bonus damage equal to your Tick Value plus your Occult Education Rank. This loss of Hit Points cannot be prevented in any way.

techniques.Name: Berserk Blow
techniques.Effect: The Move causes the target to become [[status:Vulnerable]] for 1 full round, and the Move's Critical Hit Range is increased by +3.

techniques.Name: Energy Link
techniques.Effect: For one full round, the next Normal-Type attack to hit the target instead deals Damage of the same Type as this Attack. If the Attack [[feature:Energy Link]] was applied to was already Normal-Typed, for one full round, the next Normal-Type attack to hit the target instead deals damage as if it was one step more Super-Effective.

techniques.Name: Enlarged Power
techniques.Effect: The Move gains the keyword Burst 1 if Melee 1-Target, or Blast 2 if ranged 1-Target. If the Move is already a Burst, Blast, Cone, or Line, increase the size of the Move's Range by 1.

techniques.Name: Lock of Fate
techniques.Effect: The Move cannot be Intercepted, and targets may not avoid the attack in any way if hits (such as via [[ability:Dodge]], [[ability:Parry]], [[keyword:Shield]] Moves, etc). Evasion still applies, and the Move can still Miss.

features.Name: Fortress
features.Target: You target an enemy with a Struggle attack or Weapon Attack and end your turn adjacent to the target.
features.Effect: You Mark all targets of the attack until the end of your next turn. Marked foes take a penalty to Attack Rolls against any targets besides you equal to your Focus Rank. A Mark from a different source (such as a second [[feature:Fortress]] or a Fighting [[feature:Type Ace]]'s Pokémon) will overwrite your Mark.

features.Name: Slow or Steady
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Analytic]] or [[ability:Battle Armor]]. You gain the chosen ability.

features.Name: Stalwart Bastion
features.Effect: While this Feature is Bound, you and all cardinally adjacent allies gain Damage Reduction equal to your Combat or Focus Rank.

features.Name: Shield Bearer
features.Effect: You may immediately ready a [[keyword:Shield]], and do not become [[status:Slowed]] as a result. You may choose to grant an adjacent Ally the Evasion and Damage Reduction bonuses from your shield instead of gaining them yourself, but these bonuses only apply as long as the ally remains adjacent to you. If you do and the ally Shifts, you may Shift alongside your ally as a Shift Action Interrupt. This cannot cause you to shift more than your normal Movement.

features.Name: Wall of Iron
features.Effect: You learn the moves [[move:Iron Defense]] and [[move:Protect]].

features.Name: Guardian's Punishment
features.Trigger: You hit a Marked Foe with a Damaging Weapon Attack
features.Effect: Add your Defense Stat to the Damage Roll. The Marked Foe takes a penalty to Damage Rolls equal to your Combat or Focus Rank for 1 full round.

features.Name: Unstoppable Will
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Slow or Steady]], Expert Combat or Focus
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Discipline]] Ability.

features.Name: Marksman
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Sniper]] Ability.

features.Name: Aiming Down The Sights
features.Effect: Your next Weapon Attack with a long-range Weapon gains +2 to its Accuracy Roll and Critical Hit Range. This effect lasts until used or until the start of your next turn.

features.Name: Double Shot
features.Effect: You may make two Struggle Attacks with a -2 penalty to Accuracy, each targeting the same foe. If the first attack gains the benefit of Aiming Down the Sights or [[feature:Clear Shot]], the second attack also gains the same benefits for free.

features.Name: Overwatch
features.Effect: Create a Line X, and place a Blast 3 with at least three meters overlapping the Line's area. X is equal to your Weapon's Range. For one full round, if a foe moves in or out of that area, you may make a Ranged Weapon attack, Frequency allowing, against that foe as a Free Action. You may not attack a specific foe more than once per round this way. While this is in effect, if you Move from your current location, [[feature:Overwatch]]'s effect is lost.

features.Name: Clear Shot
features.Trigger: You make a ranged Weapon Attack against a target with no other combatants or Rough or Blocking Terrain within 2 meters
features.Effect: The target is considered [[status:Vulnerable]] against this attack, and you increase your Critical Hit range by +4 for this attack.

features.Name: Crippling Shot
features.Effect: Make a Ranged Struggle Attack attack with a -2 penalty to Accuracy. If you hit, the attack deals Damage as if it was resisted one step, but the target becomes [[status:Slowed]], loses 1 Speed Combat Stage, and you initiate a Trip Maneuver against the target. You may use your Perception Skill to resolve the Opposed Check if you wish.

features.Name: Dead-Eye Shot
features.Effect: Use of [[feature:Dead-Eye Shot]] must be declared at the start of the round. Nothings happens at this time. At the end of the round, the user may use their Shift Action, and then make a Ranged Weapon Attack and roll twice for Accuracy. You may resolve the attack using either result, but if you choose to use the lower result and the attack hits, it is automatically a Critical Hit.

features.Name: Skirmisher
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Flutter]] or [[ability:Vanguard]]. You gain the Chosen Ability.

features.Name: Nimble Steps
features.Effect: You may perform the Disengage Maneuver as a Swift Action.

features.Name: Counter Stance
features.Trigger: An adjacent foe misses you with an attack
features.Effect: You perform an Attack of Opportunity against them.

features.Name: Harrier
features.Trigger: You hit a foe with a damaging Attack
features.Effect: Until the end of your next turn, that foe is considered Flanked, is [[status:Slowed]], and cannot take actions as [[keyword:Priority]] or [[keyword:Interrupt]]. [[feature:Harrier]] may only be used on a foe once per Scene.

features.Name: Weapon Finesse
features.Trigger: You hit a foe with a Weapon Attack.
features.Effect: After the attack is resolved, you may immediately use a Disarm, Trip, or Push Maneuver against that foe as a Free Action. The Maneuver automatically hits, but you must still make an Opposed Roll.

features.Name: Outmaneuver
features.Trigger: You use a damaging Attack
features.Effect: Add half your Evasion to your Accuracy Roll for the attack, and all foes hit by the attack have their Initiative reduced by your full Evasion value.

features.Name: Swift Strikes
features.Effect: Use a Weapon Attack as if it had the [[keyword:Priority]] Keyword. If the Move already had the [[keyword:Priority]] Keyword, use it as if it had the [[keyword:Priority]] (Advanced) Keyword instead.

features.Name: Arachnid's Embrace
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Unnerve]] Ability.

features.Name: How To Shoot Web
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Threaded]] and [[capability:Wallclimber]] Capabilities.

features.Name: Broodlord
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Enhanced Embrace]] Rank 2, Expert Command or Survival
features.Effect: You gain [[ability:Tinted Lens]].

features.Name: Pheromone Markers
features.Trigger: You hit a foe with a damaging Bug-Type attack
features.Effect: The triggering foe gains 1 Pheromone Stack. Your Bug-Type attacks gain a +2 bonus to Accuracy Rolls and +1 Critical Hit range against foes for each Pheromone Stack they have. Once per Scene per foe, when they gain their third or higher Pheromone Stack, you may choose to roll 1d6. On a result of 1–2, the foe becomes Confused; on 3–4, [[status:Suppressed]]; on 5–6, Enraged.

features.Name: Enhanced Embrace
features.Effect: Learn two Moves from the list below at the Rank of [[feature:Enhanced Embrace]] you are taking or lower. Moves marked with an Embrace require that Embrace to be chosen.

features.Name: Monarch's Embrace
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Shield Dust]] Ability.

features.Name: How To Shoot Web
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Threaded]] and [[capability:Wallclimber]] Capabilities.

features.Name: Broodlord
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Enhanced Embrace]] Rank 2, Expert Command or Survival
features.Effect: You gain [[ability:Compound Eyes]].

features.Name: Pheromone Markers
features.Trigger: You hit a foe with a damaging Bug-Type attack
features.Effect: The triggering foe gains 1 Pheromone Stack. Your Bug-Type attacks gain a +2 bonus to Accuracy Rolls and +1 Critical Hit range against foes for each Pheromone Stack they have. Once per Scene per foe, when they gain their third or higher Pheromone Stack, you may choose to roll 1d6. On a result of 1–2, the foe becomes Confused; on 3–4, [[status:Suppressed]]; on 5–6, Enraged.

features.Name: Enhanced Embrace
features.Effect: Learn two Moves from the list below at the Rank of [[feature:Enhanced Embrace]] you are taking or lower. Moves marked with an Embrace require that Embrace to be chosen.

features.Name: Shade Caller
features.Effect: You learn the Moves Faint Attack and [[move:Snarl]].

features.Name: Twisted Soul
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Twisted Power]] Ability.

features.Name: Living Shadow
features.Effect: Your own Shadow can attack others; you may have your Dark Type Moves originate from any Square adjacent to you. If you are fighting among complete darkness, you may have your Dark Type Moves originate from any square within X meters that is completely dark, where X is the higher of your Guile or Stealth Rank. Attacks originating from [[feature:Living Shadow]] do not trigger effects that rely on being hit with a melee attack.

features.Name: Sharpen Shadows
features.Effect: You learn [[move:Dark Pulse]] and [[move:Night Slash]]

features.Name: Heart of Darkness
features.Effect: You learn [[move:Night Daze]] and [[move:Punishment]]

features.Name: World of Darkness
features.Effect: You create a zone of Shifting Darkness in a Burst 2 around you, which persists until the end of the encounter. All targets without [[capability:Darkvision]] attacking from or into the Shifting Darkness receive a -3 penalty to Accuracy. You may count Shifting Darkness as complete darkness for the purposes of activating your [[feature:Living Shadow]]. As a Static effect, you also gain the [[capability:Darkvision]] Capability.

features.Name: Dark Soul
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Shadow Tag]] or [[ability:Super Luck]]. You gain the chosen Ability.

features.Name: Herald of Pride
features.Effect: When wielding Melee Weapons, you may use Command or Intimidate instead of Combat to determine the Damage Base of your Struggle Attacks, to resist Disarm Maneuvers, and to qualify for a Weapon's Moves. Your Weapon Attacks ignore Damage Reduction up to your Command or Intimidate Rank.

features.Name: Noblesse Oblige
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Regal Challenge]] Ability.

features.Name: Channel the Dragon's Spirit
features.Trigger: You use a Weapon Attack
features.Effect: You may have the triggering attack deal Dragon-Type Damage if you wish. On 18+, all targets can only use At-Will Frequency Moves for one full round.

features.Name: Bare the Dragon's Claws
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Herald of Pride]], Adept Command or Intimidate
features.Effect: Your learn the Moves [[move:Dragon Claw]] and [[move:Dragon Tail]]. You may use these Moves as Weapon Attacks when wielding Melee Weapons.

features.Name: Call the Dragon's Rage
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Bare the Dragon's Claws]], Master Command or Intimidate
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Dragon Rush]] and [[move:Outrage]]. You may use these Moves as Weapon Attacks when wielding Melee Weapons.

features.Name: Rouse the Dragon's Blood
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Herald of Pride]], Expert Command or Intimidate
features.Trigger: You suffer a Critical Hit or gain an Injury from a foe's attack
features.Effect: For 1 full round, the next [[feature:Herald of Pride]] Move you use against the triggering foe cannot miss, cannot be Intercepted, and effects that would cause it to miss cannot be activated against it.

features.Name: Sovereignty
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Herald of Pride]], Expert Command or Intimidate
features.Effect: While this Feature is bound, you gain a +2 Bonus to Save Checks against Volatile Status Afflictions, and a +2 Bonus to Opposed Checks when defending against being Disarmed, Grappled, Pushed, or [[status:Tripped]].

features.Name: Spark Master
features.Effect: Choose Static or [[ability:Electrodash]]. You gain the Chosen Ability.

features.Name: Magnetize
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Magnetic]] Capability and may use this magnetism to stick to surfaces with significant metal content (ex: metal walls obviously, concrete with metal I-beams inside, etc). You may use your Overland to traverse any such surfaces, even if that means walking vertically up a wall or upside down on a ceiling. You may choose not to be Pushed when on such a surface.

features.Name: Body of Lightning
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Volt Absorb]] or [[ability:Motor Drive]]. You gain the Chosen Ability.

features.Name: Bottled Lightning
features.Target: An item made of conductive material
features.Effect: Choose one of your Electric Type Moves with a target. You Charge the target item with this Move. [[feature:Bottled Lightning]] counts as using the Move for frequency purposes. You may expend this [[move:Charge]] as a Swift Action on your turn to use the Move the item was charged with, originating from the item. If a Pokémon or Trainer touches a Charged item, you may instead activate this Swift Action as if it had the [[keyword:Priority]] keyword. At the end of a Scene, all items lose their [[move:Charge]], and you may only have X items Charged at a time where X is half your Focus Rank.

features.Name: Storm Wizard
features.Effect: You may learn two Moves from the list below, marked with the [[feature:Storm Wizard]] Rank you are gaining or lower.

features.Name: Glamour Weaver
features.Prerequisites: [[edge:Elemental Connection]] (Fairy), Novice Charm, Novice Occult Education
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Sweet Kiss]] and [[move:Disarming Voice]].

features.Name: Fey Law
features.Frequency: You hit a foe with a damaging Fairy attack
features.Effect: Choose one of the following: Status-Class, Combat Maneuver, attacks with an unmodified Damage Base 10 or higher, or an Elemental Type. The triggering foe is Bound; they suffer a -X penalty to all rolls made to use attacks with the chosen trait. X is equal to half your Charm or Occult Education Rank. The Bound condition lasts until the end of a Scene. You may unbind someone as a Free Action at any time. A target may not have multiple instances of Bound applied at once.

features.Name: Passionato Harmony
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Glamour Weaver]], Expert Charm or Occult Education
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Dazzling Gleam]] and [[move:Draining Kiss]].

features.Name: Lucky Clover Grand Finale
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Passionato Harmony]], Master Charm or Occult Education
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Moonblast]] and [[move:Aromatic Mist]].

features.Name: Glamour Mastery
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Magic Guard]] or [[ability:Magic Bounce]]. You gain the Chosen Ability.

features.Name: Enchanting Transformation
features.Effect:
You perform a magical transformation on yourself. While this Feature is Bound, you gain +5 Damage Resistance against Dragon, Fighting, Dark, and Bug-Typed attacks and your [[feature:Glamour Weaver]] Moves have the additional effects below.
» [[move:Sweet Kiss]]: [[move:Sweet Kiss]] ignores Speed Evasion. » [[move:Disarming Voice]]: You may also choose to use [[move:Disarming Voice]] as a Line 4 or Cone 2.
» [[move:Dazzling Gleam]]: On Even-Numbered rolls, targets hit by [[move:Dazzling Gleam]] have their Accuracy Lowered by 1.
» [[move:Draining Kiss]]: You gain an additional Tick of Hit Points when gaining Hit Points from [[move:Draining Kiss]].
» [[move:Moonblast]]: Whenever Moonblast misses a target, they lose a Tick of Hit Points.
» [[move:Aromatic Mist]]: All allies affected by [[move:Aromatic Mist]] gain a +2 bonus to their next Save Check.

features.Name: Magical Burst
features.Trigger: You must have [[feature:Enchanting Transformation]] Bound to use [[feature:Magical Burst]]
features.Effect: Use a [[feature:Glamour Weaver]] Move as if it had the range Burst 3, [[keyword:Friendly]], [[keyword:Exhaust]], [[keyword:Smite]]. All allies within the area-of-effect gain a Tick of Temporary Hit Points or cure themselves of one Volatile Affliction. [[feature:Enchanting Transformation]] immediately becomes Unbound, and the AP used to bind it becomes spent instead of becoming available again.

features.Name: Fire Bringer
features.Effect: Choose two of [[move:Flame Burst]], [[move:Flame Wheel]], [[move:Flame Charge]], or [[move:Will-O-Wisp]]. You learn the chosen Moves.

features.Name: Fiery Soul
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Heater]] Capability, and are immune to the Burn condition.

features.Name: Firebrand
features.Effect: Your Fire-Type Moves Burn Targets on a roll of 19+. If a move already has a chance of Burning foes, [[feature:Firebrand]] increases the effect range by +2.

features.Name: Burning Passion
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Flash Fire]] or [[ability:Flame Body]]. You gain the chosen Ability.

features.Name: Blazing Inferno
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Fire Breather]] Rank 2, Master Focus or Combat
features.Effect: You becoming Blazing. While you are Blazing, whenever your Fire-Type Moves Inflict Burn, the [[status:Burned]] target immediately loses a Tick of Hit Points, and loses an additional Combat Stage in Defense. While Blazing, when you hit a foe with a damaging Fire-Type Move, you may choose to automatically burn one target of the Move. If you do, you lose the Blazing Condition after the Move's effects are resolved.

features.Name: Fire Breather
features.Effect: Learn two [[feature:Fire Bringer]] Moves from the list below. You may choose any Move marked with the [[feature:Fire Breather]] Rank you are taking or lower.

features.Name: Wind Runner
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Levitate]] Ability. You have a total Levitate Speed equal to 4 plus half of the higher of your Acrobatics or Perception Rank.

features.Name: One With the Winds
features.Effect: You summon a windy breeze that follows you around. Your sense of touch is extended through this wind, and you can guide it by thought, using it to perceive the shape and texture of objects as long as the wind can reach, even through very small cracks and holes. The range of this effect is equal to your Acrobatics Rank plus Perception Rank in meters.

features.Name: Flight
features.Effect: You gain a Sky Speed equal to your Levitate Speed plus your Acrobatics or Perception Rank for the remainder of the round.

features.Name: Gale Speed
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Raging Winds]] Rank 1, Master Acrobatics or Perception
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Celebrate]] or [[ability:Gale Wings]]. You gain the chosen Ability.

features.Name: Raging Winds
features.Effect: You may learn two Moves from the list below, marked with the [[feature:Raging Winds]] Rank you are gaining or lower.

features.Name: Apparition
features.Prerequisites: [[edge:Elemental Connection]] (Ghost), Novice Intimidate, Novice Occult Education
features.Effect: When wielding Melee Weapons, you may use Occult Education or Intimidate instead of Combat to determine the Damage Base of your Struggle Attacks, to resist Disarm Maneuvers, and to qualify for a Weapon's Moves. Your Weapon Attacks always treat you as having the [[capability:Reach]] Capability, and foes may not activate [[keyword:Reaction]] effects against them that specify being hit by a Melee Attack.

features.Name: Shadow Arms
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Shadow Punch]] and [[move:Shadow Sneak]]. You may use these as Weapon Attacks when wielding Melee Weapons.

features.Name: Too Spooky
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Pressure]] or [[ability:Frighten]]. You gain the chosen Ability.

features.Name: Silent Assassin
features.Effect: While this Feature is Bound, your Struggle Attacks and Weapon Attacks deal Ghost-Type Damage, and you gain the [[capability:Dead Silent]] Capability.

features.Name: Shadow Form
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Silent Assassin]], Expert Intimidate or Occult Education
features.Effect: While this Feature is Bound, your appearance becomes wan and obviously otherworldly. Your natural Weaknesses, Resistances, and Immunities change to match that of the Ghost Type. Additionally, while in [[feature:Shadow Form]], you are immune to the [[status:Cursed]] Status (if you were previously [[status:Cursed]], you are instantly cured upon going into [[feature:Shadow Form]]) and gain the [[capability:Phasing]] Capability. You may unbind this Feature as a Swift Action, returning to your normal appearance.

features.Name: Phantom Menace
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Shadow Arms]], Expert Intimidate or Occult Education
features.Effect: You gain the Moves [[move:Shadow Claw]] and [[move:Phantom Force]]. You may use these Moves as Weapon Attacks when wielding Melee Weapons.

features.Name: Haunted Wounds
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Shadow Arms]], Master Intimidate or Occult Education
features.Trigger: You hit with an [[feature:Apparition]] Move or Ghost-Typed Weapon Attack
features.Effect: After one full round, repeat the triggering attack against one target as a Free Action, regardless of range. If this attack hits, it deals damage as if it were resisted one step further. [[feature:Haunted Wounds]] may only affect a target once per Scene.

features.Name: Flower Oath
features.Prerequisites: [[edge:Elemental Connection]] (Grass), Novice Survival, Novice General Education
features.Effect: Your powers begin to take after Flowers. [[feature:Flower Oath]] grants you [[ability:Aroma Veil]] Ability and [+Special Attack] tag to Druid Features.

features.Name: Green Path
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Naturewalk]] (Grassland) and [[capability:Naturewalk]] (Forest) capabilities, and you are immune to Moves with the [[keyword:Powder]] keyword.

features.Name: Overgrowth
features.Trigger: You hit with a Druid Move
features.Effect: One target of the triggering Move is afflicted with [[feature:Overgrowth]]. As long as the target is afflicted, they are one step less Resistant to Grass-Type attacks (to a maximum of neutral damage) and cannot recover Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points. Whenever they would do so, you gain those Hit Points or Temporary Hit Points instead. [[feature:Overgrowth]] is removed when the target Takes a Breather or is hit by a damaging Fire, Ice, Poison, Flying, or Bug-Type attack. A target may only be affected once per Scene.

features.Name: Druid's Call
features.Effect: Six flowery bushes suddenly grow within 6 meters of you, occupying 1 square each. This vegetation lasts until the end of the encounter and acts as rough terrain that blocks line of sight for Pokémon and Trainers without the [[capability:Naturewalk]] (Forest) capability. Whenever you use a Move learned through [[feature:Nature's Embrace]], you may have it originate from these Plants as if they were the user. This Feature must be used on soil, or on terrain where only a few inches cover the soil (such as most sidewalks, parking lots, gravel, or woodchip lots).

features.Name: Nature's Embrace
features.Effect: You learn two Moves chosen from the list below, marked with the Rank of this Feature you are gaining or lower.

features.Name: Fungal Oath
features.Prerequisites: [[edge:Elemental Connection]] (Grass), Novice Survival, Novice General Education
features.Effect: Your powers begin to take after Fungi. [[feature:Fungal Oath]] grants you [[ability:Effect Spore]] Ability and [+Special Defense] tag to Druid Features.
