features.Name: Nature's Embrace
features.Effect: You learn two Moves chosen from the list below, marked with the Rank of this Feature you are gaining or lower.

features.Name: Earth Shaker
features.Effect: Pick two of [[move:Bulldoze]], [[move:Mud Shot]], or Sand-Attack. You learn the chosen Moves.

features.Name: Earthen Bond
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Tremorsense]] Capability, and you gain [[capability:Naturewalk]] for Cave, Mountain and Desert.

features.Name: Earth Mother's Blessing
features.Effect: Each Rank, choose [[ability:Arena Trap]] or [[ability:Lightning Rod]]. You gain the chosen Ability.

features.Name: Earthshifter
features.Trigger: You hit with a damaging Ground Type Move
features.Effect: You initiate a Trip Maneuver against 1 target of the Move. The Maneuver automatically hits, and you may use your Focus or Intuition for the opposed check.

features.Name: Ground Out
features.Effect: Pick two of [[move:Drill Run]], [[move:Magnitude]], or [[move:Mud Bomb]]. You learn the chosen Moves.

features.Name: Tectonic Shift
features.Effect: Pick two of [[move:Earthquake]], [[move:Earth Power]], or [[move:Sand Tomb]]. You learn the chosen Moves.

features.Name: Frost Touched
features.Effect: Choose two out of [[move:Haze]], [[move:Ice Shard]], [[move:Mist]], and [[move:Powder Snow]]. You learn the Chosen Moves.

features.Name: The Cold Never Bothered Me Anyway
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Naturewalk]] (Tundra) Capability, are immune to being [[status:Frozen]], and do not lose Hit Points from [[move:Hail]].

features.Name: Glacial Defense
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Ice Shield]] or [[ability:Winter's Kiss]]. You gain the Chosen Ability.

features.Name: Frozen Domain
features.Effect: Set 6 square meters of [[feature:Frozen Domain]] within range 6. All 6 meters must be adjacent with at least one other space of [[feature:Frozen Domain]]. All legal targets passing through these squares must make an Acrobatics check with a DC equal to 4 + twice your Survival Rank. On failure, the target is [[status:Tripped]]. Pokémon who are flying, levitating, or have the [[capability:Naturewalk]] (Tundra) Capability are immune to this effect. When standing on a square affected by [[feature:Frozen Domain]], you may act as if you were in [[move:Hail]] weather. When a Fire-Type attack originates from or targets a square of [[feature:Frozen Domain]], that square of [[feature:Frozen Domain]] melts and is cleared. [[feature:Frozen Domain]] is considered a [[keyword:Hazard]].

features.Name: Winter is Coming
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Frostbite]] Ability.

features.Name: Winter's Herald
features.Effect: You may learn two Moves from the list below, marked with the Rank of [[feature:Winter's Herald]] you are gaining or lower.

features.Name: Prism
features.Prerequisites: [[edge:Elemental Connection]] (Normal), Novice General Education, Novice Charm
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Flash]] and Swift.

features.Name: Blinding Brightness
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Illuminate]] Ability.

features.Name: Sparkle
features.Effect: You learn the Moves Tri-Attack and [[move:Weather Ball]].

features.Name: Rainbow Surge
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Hyper Beam]] and [[move:Morning Sun]].

features.Name: Lucent Mirage
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Illusionist]] Capability.

features.Name: Luminous Aura
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Blinding Brightness]], Adept Charm or General Education
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Starlight]] or [[ability:Sunglow]]. You gain the Chosen Ability.

features.Name: Prismatic Alignment
features.Prerequisites: 4 [[feature:Prism]] Features, Master Charm or General Education
features.Trigger: You use a [[feature:Prism]] Move
features.Effect:
The effect of this Feature depends on the Triggering Move. You may only use [[feature:Prismatic Alignment]] with each Move once per Scene.
» [[move:Flash]]: [[move:Flash]] also Blinds all targets it hits until the end of their next turn.
» Swift: Swift instead has a range of 8, 3 Targets
» [[move:Tri Attack]]: Roll twice for [[move:Tri Attack]]'s Accuracy Roll and take the better result. If you trigger its Effect Range, you may choose the effect instead of rolling for it.
» [[move:Weather Ball]]: You use [[move:Weather Ball]] as if you were in the [[keyword:Weather]] of your choice.
» [[move:Hyper Beam]]: [[move:Hyper Beam]] instead has a Range of Burst 2, [[keyword:Smite]] or 10, Ranged Blast 3, [[keyword:Smite]].
» [[move:Morning Sun]]: You use [[move:Morning Sun]] as if you were in Sunny Weather, and you may cure yourself of one Status Affliction.

features.Name: Miasmic
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Acid]] and [[move:Clear Smog]].

features.Name: Corrupt Blood
features.Effect: You are immune to the [[status:Poisoned]] and [[status:Badly Poisoned]] statuses and resist Poison-type attacks one step further.

features.Name: Flexible Form
features.Effect: Your body becomes more malleable, and even your bones are able to flex when required. You do not gain Injuries from taking Massive damage, and you gain a +2 Bonus to any Acrobatics or Athletics Check made to bend, squeeze, or otherwise contort your body -including those to avoid Trip or Grapple maneuvers.

features.Name: Vile Body
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Absorb Force]], [[ability:Poison Point]], or [[ability:Poison Touch]]. You gain the chosen Ability.

features.Name: Miasma's Call
features.Effect: You learn the moves [[move:Acid Armor]] and [[move:Sludge Bomb]].

features.Name: Miasma Unleashed
features.Effect: You learn the moves [[move:Sludge Wave]] and [[move:Toxic]].

features.Name: Miasmic Spray
features.Trigger: You hit with [[move:Acid]], [[move:Clear Smog]], [[move:Sludge Bomb]], [[move:Sludge Wave]], or [[move:Toxic]]; or use [[move:Acid Armor]].
features.Effect:
The Effect of this feature depends on the triggering move.
» [[move:Acid]]: Instead of its usual effect, [[move:Acid]] lowers the Special Defense of all targets hit by -2 Combat Stages.
» [[move:Clear Smog]]: [[move:Clear Smog]]'s target loses 5 HP for each combat stage lost.
» [[move:Sludge Bomb]]: The Target receives a -3 penalty to Accuracy Rolls until the end of your next turn.
» [[move:Sludge Wave]]: All targets in [[move:Sludge Wave]]'s Burst are [[status:Slowed]] until the end of their next turn.
» [[move:Toxic]]: The target's Badly Poison Hit Point Loss begins at 10 instead of 5.
» [[move:Acid Armor]]: You are not slowed while liquefied and resist all special damage one step.

features.Name: Stone Warrior
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Rock Tomb]] and [[move:Wide Guard]].

features.Name: Stone Stance
features.Effect:
You adopt one of the stances below, gaining the effects of the stance while this Feature remains bound. You may switch your active Stance as a Standard Action without rebinding your AP. The benefits from this Feature do not apply if you are not standing on a solid surface, such as deep mud or snow, or if you are outright swimming or even flying.
» Falling Boulder Stance: You gain a +5 bonus to all Damage Rolls, but lose 5 HP from [[keyword:Recoil]] whenever you hit with an attack.
» Moon Mountain Stance: Your initiative is lowered by -5, but you gain 5 Damage Reduction and are immune to [[keyword:Push]] or Pull effects.
» Roiling Earth Stance: After a successful Intercept action, you may make a Struggle Attack against a foe within range.

features.Name: Rock Power
features.Effect: Each Rank, choose one of [[ability:Sturdy]], [[ability:Rock Head]], Run Up, or [[ability:Sand Veil]]. You gain the chosen Ability. If you choose [[ability:Sand Veil]], you may consider sand a "solid surface" for the purposes of [[feature:Stone Stance]].

features.Name: Shards of Stone
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Rock Slide]] and [[move:Stealth Rock]]

features.Name: Stone Cold Finish
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Shards of Stone]], Master Combat or Survival
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Stone Edge]] and [[move:Head Smash]].

features.Name: Stone Stance Mastery
features.Effect: Whenever you bind [[feature:Stone Stance]], you may choose two Stances and apply the effects of both.

features.Name: Steelheart
features.Effect: When wielding metal Melee Weapons, you may use Athletics or Focus instead of Combat to determine the Damage Base of your Struggle Attacks, to qualify for a Weapon's Moves, and to resist Disarm Checks. Whenever your Weapon Attacks hit a foe who has previously hit you with a Melee attack in the same round, the foe loses a Tick of Hit Points.

features.Name: Champion of Steel
features.Trigger: You make a Weapon Attack.
features.Effect: The attack or Move increases your Defense by 1 Combat Stage on 16+ and you may have it deal Steel-Type Damage if you wish.

features.Name: Steel Wind
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Bullet Punch]] and [[move:Metal Claw]]. You may use these Moves as Weapon Attacks when wielding Melee Weapons.

features.Name: Reactive Armour
features.Trigger: You gain an Injury or take a Critical Hit while wearing metallic Armor
features.Effect: All foes within a Burst 1 lose Hit Points equal to double your Athletics or Focus Rank, and you gain Damage Reduction equal to double your Athletics or Focus Rank for one full round.

features.Name: Impenetrable
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Bulletproof]] Ability.

features.Name: Master of Arms
features.Effect: You learn the Call to Arms and Unlimited Steel Works Talents.

talents.Name: Call to Arms
talents.Effect: You create a Steelheart Bond with the target Weapon. You may only have one Steelheart Bond at a time; if you create a new Bond, all old Bonds are lost. As a Shift Action, you may beckon your Steelheart Bonded Weapon to your hands if it is within 10 meters. If it is being held by someone else who does not want to let go of the weapon, make an Athletics or Focus vs Athletics Opposed Check. If you win, they their lose grip on your Weapon and it flies to your hand as normal.

talents.Name: Unlimited Steel Works
talents.Effect: You may replace the Move(s) granted by the target Weapon with any other standard Weapon Moves, within Limitations. Weapons may still only grant one Adept and one Master Move at a maximum.

features.Name: Man of Steel
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Meteor Mash]] and [[move:King's Shield]]. You may use these Moves as Weapon Attacks when wielding Melee Weapons.

features.Name: Maelstrom
features.Effect: You gain the [[capability:Gilled]] Capability, and a +2 bonus to your Swim speed. Whenever your Water-Type Moves miss all targets, you gain a Tick of Temporary Hit Points.

features.Name: Water's Shroud
features.Effect: Choose [[ability:Wash Away]] or [[ability:Storm Drain]]. You gain the Chosen Ability.

features.Name: Hydro Jet
features.Trigger: You use a damaging single target Water-Type Move
features.Effect:
[[feature:Hydro Jet]]'s effect depends on if the triggering Move was Melee or Ranged.
» If Melee, the Move gains the [[keyword:Pass]] keyword and you may change direction during the four meters of [[keyword:Pass]] (but may still only target any given Pokémon or Trainer once).» If Ranged, the Move becomes a Line 4 instead of its usual range.

features.Name: Oceanic Feeling
features.Trigger: See Text
features.Effect: You may activate [[feature:Oceanic Feeling]] when either [[ability:Wash Away]] or [[ability:Storm Drain]] would be triggered to gain that Ability for 1 full round, if you do not already have it, and immediately [[keyword:Trigger]] it. Activating an Ability this way ignores its usual Frequency. You may use each Ability once per Scene this way.

features.Name: Call The Current
features.Effect: You learn 2 Moves chosen from the list below, marked with the Rank of this Feature you are gaining or lower.

features.Name: Glitch Bender
features.Prerequisites: [[edge:Glitched Existence]], Novice Focus, Occult Education, or Perception
features.Effect: You gain the [[ability:Synchronize]] Ability.

features.Name: I Am Error
features.Trigger: You gain a Status Affliction
features.Effect: Roll 1d10 and change which Status Affliction is gained according to the following chart. If the target already has that Status Affliction, roll again.

features.Name: Null Error
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Disable]] and [[move:Snatch]].

features.Name: Corrupt Reality
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Glitch Bender]], Adept Perception, Occult Education, or Focus
features.Target: Any roll made by a foe
features.Effect: You may force the foe to reroll that roll.

features.Name: Code Injection
features.Target: A Pokémon or Trainer within 5 meters
features.Effect:
You may use any of the Glitches below. They are treated as a Status-Class attack with an AC of 2. You may only use each Glitch once per Scene, and each target may only be affected by [[feature:Code Injection]] once per Scene.
» Object Not Found: The target may not benefit from Equipment, Held Items, and consumable Items for one full round.
» Access Denied: The target is [[status:Slowed]] and may only take At-Will actions for one full round.
» Blue Screen: The target is Blinded and [[status:Vulnerable]] for one full round.

features.Name: Glitch Shuffle
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Glitch Bender]], Expert Perception, Occult Education, or Focus
features.Effect: You learn the Moves [[move:Metronome]] and [[move:Topsy-Turvy]]

features.Name: Glitch Burst
features.Prerequisites: [[feature:Glitch Shuffle]], Master Perception, Occult Education, or Focus
features.Trigger: You hit with [[move:Topsy-Turvy]] or use another [[feature:Glitch Bender]] Move
features.Effect:
[[feature:Glitch Burst]]'s effect depends on the triggering Move.
» [[move:Disable]]: The target of [[move:Disable]] is also [[status:Suppressed]].
» [[move:Snatch]]: Regain one use of a [[feature:Glitch Bender]] Move. This may only affect each Move once per Scene.
» [[move:Metronome]]: Generate three random Moves instead of one, and choose which Move to use.
» [[move:Topsy-Turvy]]: The target of [[move:Topsy-Turvy]] becomes Confused. They are automatically cured of this [[status:Confusion]] at the end of their next turn.
